sections.title: MARANTZ DAC-1
sections.overview:
160,000 (released in 1988)  146,000 (around 1989)

This is a digital audio control amplifier with the purpose of limiting the music source and displaying its power.Audio signals that pass through a D/A converter after PCM processing such as CD a D/A converter contain a large amount of noise (out of audible frequency band noise). This was developed based on the idea that a signal without this noise is sent to a power amplifier.The input stage is equipped with a low-pass filter based on the CD technology of the Phillips-Marantz Group. This filter allows only signals below the sampling frequency to pass and suppresses intermodulation caused by high frequencies in the amplifier section.By providing a buffer amplifier in front of the master volume, it is possible to use a low-impedance volume and to reduce noise level fluctuations caused by volume position.It uses a trans-coupled multi-feedback circuit based on the output circuit used in the LHH2000. It moderately reduces unnecessary bands other than 20 Hz to 20 kHz and smoothly extracts only audio signals.Furthermore, by providing a gain of + 14 dB, it is possible to drive the power amplifier with a margin.Also, by installing an output transformer, we have succeeded in completely separating the chassis ground and the output system ground.By adopting the dual winding method for the secondary winding of the output transformer, different 180   phase signals of positive phase output and negative phase output are output to Output 2. By using these two outputs, BTL drive of the power amplifier is possible (Marantz power amplifier only).In addition, by using outputs with different phases, connection of absolute phase is possible.Output 2 can be used to drive a positive-phase power amplifier in reverse phase or a negative-phase speaker in reverse phase.In pursuit of the ideal sound quality, each part also uses parts that pursue quality.Toroidal transformer is used for the power transformer and super permalloy core is used for the output transformer.Non-magnetic gold plating is used for the input / output terminals. In addition, solid aluminum is used for the volume knob in order to prevent sound pressure energy from the speaker, which is said to cause resonance and vibration of the whole amplifier, especially the volume knob.A flip-coated glass epoxy substrate is used for the printed circuit board to improve insulation resistance.In addition, a non-magnetic copper-plated chassis is used for the chassis, an 8 mm aluminum front panel and two 1.3 kg die-cast side panels are used to reduce resonance, and a 4 mm aluminum top cover is used to reduce squeal.It inherits the design philosophy of the output transformer of LHH2000 and can be combined with the digital line TRANSFORMERS DLT-1 for reproduction.

sections.overview: As a control console, it is a control amplifier that pursues rich functions.The equalizer amplifier uses a specially designed low-noise differential input amplifier, buffer amplifier and A-class amplifier with constant current load. It can be used for MC cartridges by simply switching the selector.In addition to the conventional Bass and Treble, a Mid-position tritone control is used for the tone control section.The tone amplifier consists of a differential amplifier and is a low-distortion NF type. sections.overview: A control amplifier developed for Low-TIM.The equalizer stage is responsible for amplifying the weak output from the record and compensating for the recording characteristics. The first stage is a cascode differential circuit with low-noise FET ? phase inversion amplifier, the second stage is a complete push-pull amplifier circuit, and the output stage is a DC-configuration equalizer stage with low distortion and good transient characteristics with Darlington SEPP. Furthermore, the first stage FET is a luxurious FET specially made by Marantz that has low-noise characteristics and excellent thermal and electrical pair characteristics. As a result, the S/N ratio is exactly 90 dB (IHF-A) at 7.75 mV input. In addition, the RIAA deviation, which indicates the accuracy of record reproduction, is   0.2 dB (20 Hz to 20 kHz) by carefully selecting an equalizer element with good characteristics and high accuracy.It has a built-in MC head amplifier, a DC configuration using a low-noise FET at the first stage, and an extremely low feedback impedance to improve the S/N ratio.While listening to FM music, you can record completely different sources on each of the two decks independently, from the Phono input on the A deck and from the AUX terminal on the B deck. This not only expands deck play, but also eliminates the hassle of pin plug connections when dubbing from deck to deck, and improves playability.For faithful disc playback, the impedance matching between the cartridge and the amplifier must be accurate. The SC-7 comes with a selector that can be easily adjusted to 5 levels of 1k   ~ 100k   for MM type and 4 levels of 10   ~ 220   for MC type.It is equipped with a tritone control for room equalization in any sound field. The tone amplifier is composed of DC-differential amplifier using FET ? full push-pull amplification ? SEPP. It is a BAX type with good control characteristics. In addition to the BASS TREBLE, it is equipped with the MID control for mid-range correction. The TURN-OVER switch switches the turnover frequencies from 2 kHz to 10 kHz for High and from 500 Hz to 100 Hz for Low. It is also equipped with a variety of functions from room acoustic to program correction. For example, tone correction can be added to the source during recording by linking with the TAPE EQ switch.The tone bypass switch allows the phono signal to be sent directly to the PRE-OUT without passing through the tone circuit with a single switch.A headphone amplifier of high sensitivity A class 0.5W design, volume control with low noise with 4-connection type volume adoption, gold finish input / output terminal which prevents sound quality degradation, etc. are substantial.

sections.title: MARANTZ MA-9S1
sections.overview: The power amplifier circuit, power supply, and feed line have been thoroughly reviewed to realize an instantaneous current supply capability approximately three times that of conventional products (compared to 150A SM-5).In order to minimize the effect of back electromotive force, the amplifier circuit is composed of two amplifiers, 23 dB voltage amplifier (voltage amplifier circuit) and 6 dB power buffer amplifier (power amplifier circuit) with 3 parallel, push-pull and full balance configuration.The power supply circuit for the voltage amplifier uses a choke input method that minimizes ripple components in the rectified waveform and is resistant to load fluctuations. This reduces the harmonics of the power supply and reduces noise from the primary side to peripheral audio equipment.In addition, the noise entering from the primary side is also reduced, and combined with the Schottky diode / noise killer element, clean power can be supplied to the small-signal circuit.The power supply section for the power buffer amplifier uses a capacitor input method with low impedance and high current supply capability. The super-ring large toroidal transformer, specially developed ultra-low impedance block capacitor, extra-thick wiring cable and thick foil substrate enable high current supply.In order to reduce the feedback impedance of the current feedback circuit and to realize even higher speed, we have newly developed the buffer amplifier separate module HDAM SA, which is a further evolution of Marantz original HDAM, and incorporated it into the MA-9S1.The MA-9S1 has two power buffer amplifiers and four voltage amplifiers.It has a center power meter.Equipped with a 6-stage attenuator.Machined gold-plated terminals are used for unbalanced input terminals.A speaker terminal made by WBT of Germany is installed in the speaker terminal for bi-wiring.It uses a large extruded aluminum heat sink of approximately 7.0 kg.Uses a 3.2mmx2 copper plated double layered bottom chassis.

sections.title: MARANTZ PROJECTT-1
sections.overview:
* Made-to-order products  2,500,000 (released in 1995)

A tube bulb type monaural power amplifier developed in search of a vacuum tube amplifier using the latest technology that is suitable for Marantz and suitable for the present.Each part has been carefully selected by countries around the world for reliable parts that can bring out the maximum sound quality. In addition, we aim to be a long-life product by using parts that were being manufactured at that time without using limited stocks or used balls.The internal circuit uses carefully selected highly reliable components such as film capacitors from US Aerobox, resistors from Dale, and sockets from Johnson.For the vacuum tubes, 300B is used for the first stage and driver stage, and 845 is used for the last stage in a push-pull manner. For the amplification stage, a large direct-heated triode with excellent linearity and low odd-order distortion is used. A direct-heated twin triode 5U4G is used for the B power supply rectifier for the first stage and driver stage, and a direct-heated triode 845 is used for the B power supply rectifier for the last stage.All the vacuum tubes used are carefully selected and only those that passed the Marantz standard are selected and used with the marantz logo.A class A class push-pull non-feedback amplifier (balanced configuration) with transformer coupling for all stages from input to output. This eliminates secondary distortion of the 3-pole tube and ripple of the power supply.The B power supply for the first stage and driver stage, transformer for each filament power supply, and high-voltage power transformer for the last stage are composed independently. In addition, choke coils are inserted into each stage, and the filament power supply for the amplification system is a constant current circuit, so that stable operation and inrush current when power is turned on are suppressed and the life of the vacuum tube is extended. The B voltage of each amplification stage is 184 v for the first stage, 382 v for the second stage, and 970 v for the last stage.In addition, highly reliable MP capacitors are used as filter capacitors for these power supplies.All audio transformers are manufactured by OPT (formerly UTC : United TRANSFORMERS Corporation), a reliable transformer manufacturer in the United States.A self-bias circuit is used in each amplifier stage to ensure reliability.In addition, the high-voltage power supply is equipped with a time delay circuit to prevent shock noise during power ON/OFF and no-load condition of the high-voltage power supply. Also, the high-voltage power supply is cut off even when an abnormal current flows to each B power supply of the amplifier system.The chassis has a double structure consisting of a copper plated steel chassis with beauty and strength and a thick aluminum exterior.The layout consists of two power transformers and two choke coils placed behind the top panel, and four audio transformers placed inside the enclosure under the vacuum tubes to minimize wiring and improve weight balance.The champagne gold front panel is equipped with a bias balance meter that also serves as a pilot lamp.With this meter, the DC balance condition of the vacuum tube of each stage, first stage (300B), driver stage (300B), and final stage (845) can be confirmed.One balanced input (XLR) is installed as an input terminal.The speaker output is one Canon terminal and is normally set to 8  .This setting of output load impedance could be changed depending on the service.

sections.title: MARANTZ MODEL500
sections.overview: As a high-power machine, this stereo power amplifier was developed in pursuit of how to suppress the distortion factor in the high frequency range at full power and how to eliminate distortion at mini power.The power transistor is the one jointly developed by Marantz and Motorola, and SJ is attached to the model number after M.In addition, specially ordered resistors and switches are adopted.The circuit configuration consists of the SEPP direct-coupled preamp section with a differential-amplifier circuit, followed by the power amplifier section of the normal all-stage direct-coupled pure complimentary service OCL.NF is doubly applied from the end of the preamplifier section and from the output section of the power amplifier section.This is the first time in the world that the power amplifier section has been fully push-pull from the inlet to the outlet. Therefore, even the top differential circuit is prepared with completely separate upper and lower components. Up to the final stage of pure complimentary service, the upper and lower components are amplified completely independently to obtain perfect symmetry and dynamic characteristics.The power stage consists of 8 single-channel 4-parallel stones and 3-Darlington (4-parallel stones are counted as 1 stone). This power transistor is operated in class AB by supplying sufficient idling current to suppress the notching distortion characteristic of transistor class B amplification.The protection circuit uses a 2-stone configuration that stops current at the drive stage and prevents excess current from flowing into the power transistor when some abnormal operation occurs.The limiter circuit for 500W/300W/100W power switching uses part of this protection circuit, and the operation principle is also the same.In the speaker protection circuit, when a DC voltage appears at the speaker terminal of a 3-chip amplifier, the output of the speaker terminal and the power amplifier is cut off by a relay. This also functions as muting.There are three relays in total. One is used to prevent the rush current when the power supply is turned on, and the other two are used to prevent direct current at the muting and speaker terminals.A forced-air cooling fan is installed inside.

sections.title: MARANTZ MODEL510M
sections.overview:
Model510M :   525,000 (released in 1976)Model510 :   475,000 (released in 1976)

This is a stereo power amplifier with designs such as Disi Peter and 2-layer PC-board.The Model510M is a stereo power amplifier with a meter.The Model510 has a simple design with the 510M VU meter removed.The power transistors are series parallel in two stages and two columns. The output stage consists of eight transistors per channel, a total of 16 transistors facing each other.The power transistor is cooled by a heat dissipation device called a Finger Heat Disi Peter.This system was developed based on NASA technology and consists of 12 radiating fingers. With this system, turbulence is generated around the 12 fingers with a small amount of air flow. This enables cooling with high efficiency even when the cooling fan rotates at low speed.In addition, the fan noise is reduced because the speed of the cooling fan is automatically changed to 2 stages by output.The amplifier circuit is mounted on a 2-layer printed circuit board.This protects the sensitive semiconductor part from the heat of the power transistor, and the drive stage wiring, which requires capacitance, is patterned on the second layer board with a margin to achieve both compactness and high quality.Resin and rock powder are press-fitted into the transformer used in the power supply section to eliminate booming by eliminating the internal space.We use double-sided soldering for parts soldering.Mahogany wood cabinet was sold separately as an option.

It is adopted in most audio amplifiers. In this method, static characteristics such as distortion and frequency characteristics can be improved as the amount of NFB is increased. However, dynamic characteristics are deteriorated by stabilizing a large amount of NFB. Even if an amplifier circuit or power supply is composed of high-speed elements, its ability cannot be demonstrated and it cannot follow music signals that change instantaneously.In the PA series, not only the current amplifier stage but also the voltage amplifier stage are all Non-NFB configuration which completely eliminates NFB, so the linearity of input / output is greatly improved.A fully balanced 400 VA R core transformer and 1,000 ? F / 63 ? sections.title: MARANTZ LS-80
sections.overview: A speaker system developed with a front-facing approach in order to accurately reproduce the music signal sent from the amplifier without coloring it.A 30 cm woofer made of polypropylene cone is mounted in the low range.Polypropylene cone has advantages such as superior material uniformity and strength compared with conventional paper cone, ability to expand piston motion range, low mechanical Q of high-frequency resonance (less than 1/10 of paper), and less distortion and disturbance of characteristics in high-frequency range.In addition, a 50 mm   long through voice coil has been adopted, and together with the polypropylene cone which is resistant to deformation, transient distortion at low frequency and large amplitude has been reduced.In addition, with a till-bobbin that achieves both improved heat resistance and reduced weight, input resistance is improved without losing transient characteristics.The middle area is equipped with a 12 cm cone type squaker made of polypropylene cone similar to the woofer.Low-distortion and non-colorization design common to Woofer, such as till bobbin for improved transient and input resistance, and perforated pole piece for eliminating second harmonic distortion.A newly developed dual-drive ribbon tweeter is installed in the high range.A unique dual drive magnetic circuit drives a diaphragm with a coil printed on an ultra-thin film of a polymer material (polyimide) uniformly across the entire surface, improving various characteristics.The printed coil system eliminates the need for a matching transformer, improves input resistance and sound quality, and achieves high efficiency by adopting a strong magnetic circuit and a short horn.The network section is simple and low-loss designed to take advantage of the characteristics of each unit.In addition to silicon-laminated steel core coils, audio only Chemicon and metalized polypropylene capacitors, large-capacity resistors and oxygen-free copper lead wires are used as elements.The board is fixed to the bottom of the enclosure to eliminate vibration.The enclosure uses a chip board with a higher density than ordinary enclosure materials, and the propagation and attenuation of vibration are faster, eliminating coloring caused by box rumbling, etc.In addition, the exterior is finished with a veneer that has been repeatedly colored and polished several times. The surface hardness is higher than that of the usual oil finish, and vibration disturbance is prevented.

sections.title: MARANTZ DV9500
sections.overview: A universal player developed with cutting-edge image technology and Marantz's audio technology.It is equipped with HDMI (High-Definition Multimedia Interface) which is an interface for digital audio-visual equipment. The HDMI connector can simultaneously transmit uncompressed digital video and digital audio signals such as Dolby Digital, DTS and Linear PCM.In combination with digital video equipment such as projectors equipped with this connector, full digital transmission and full digital processes are possible from the entrance to the exit.The I/P conversion and scaling part of the video processing circuit is equipped with a 10-bit digital processing circuit. By installing the latest high-precision 10-bit scaler, it is possible to upconvert 480P video signals to higher-definition 720P or 1080i signals via the HDMI terminal and output them.In progressive processing, 10-bit digital processing enables four times higher precision than general 8-bit processing. In addition, a newly developed algorithm reduces shaggy (stepped noise on diagonal lines) and produces sharp images.In addition, since the image adjustment is performed by the I/P conversion section, the image quality can be adjusted for digital output as well as analog output.The video encoder is equipped with a 216 MHz / 14-bit video encoder that oversamples interlaced signals by 16 times and progressive signals by 8 times, enabling high-precision D/A conversion and more natural contour reproduction.In addition, the 14-bit model has improved color reproducibility and luminance tone reproducibility compared to the 12-bit model. In addition, the Noise Shaped Video (NSV) technology shifts video noise components to unwanted bands, effectively removes noise with an analog filter, and suppresses signal degradation and aliasing noise, thereby improving the total video S/N ratio.Equipped with a video adjustment function, it is possible to perform real image quality adjustment such as DNR/CNR / detail / brightness / gamma / chroma delay which can be finely adjusted according to the projector and display.High-quality output circuits such as high-bandwidth video amplifiers and discrete filters are used.All 6-ch equal-quality audio output boards equipped with HDAM are mounted.In order to block the influence of the video circuit, it is separated from the video board and the whole back of the board is shielded. In addition, attention is paid to the wiring of the board and the arrangement of parts to improve the sound quality.The DAC is equipped with a total of three DAC CS4398 s made by Cirrus Logic, one each for front L/Rch, surround L/Rch, center ch & subwoofer, and one for each.There is also a separate DAC for headphones.Uses a newly developed DVD/Super Audio CD dedicated module.This mechanism is based on the one developed in S¥400, and the module with less noise radiation is realized by using one circuit board and four layers of glass epoxy board.In addition, the tray has a black paint that has an anti-vibration effect and is less affected by diffused laser reflection.In addition to the conventional double-layered chassis, the chassis strength of the main chassis top cover has been increased.Equipped with a video off mode that can turn off all video circuits after I/P conversion from the power supply / control system.Equipped with a dedicated transformer for audio circuit.Uses 0 impedance copper plate.Brass machined gold plated Analog output terminal is mounted.Equipped with DTS96/24 decoder enabling 5.1 ch playback at 96kHz/24bit.This is the world's first stand-alone DVD player equipped with a Dolby Headphone.Equipped with the Lip Sync function, when connected to a plasma display or projector, the time gap between video and audio caused by the processing time of the video circuit can be corrected up to 200 msec in 10 msec increments.Equipped with a sound mode function, you can directly select the playback area of Super Audio CD with the remote control, which had to be switched by showing the menu screen on the display in the previous model.It is equipped with delay time and bus management functions that can be adjusted during SACD playback in addition to DVD video and DVD audio.You can use the startup screen that displays a JPEG image when the power is turned on.Marantz original design is used for the GUI for initial setting.Equipped with RS232C control terminal for custom installation using controllers such as CRESTRON.Support for SACD multi-channel, DVD audio / video, video CD, SVCD, audio CD/CD-R/CD-RW, MP3 and JPEG.It has a built-in Dolby Digital / DTS decoder.Supports DVD-RW disc (video mode) playback.Equipped with PAL/NTSC conversion function.Equipped with PAL progressive playback function.Equipped with D2 video output terminal.

sections.title: MARANTZ DV9600
sections.overview:
189,000 (tax included, sold in September 2005)

This is a universal player that inherits the concept of DV9500 and supports I. LINK and HDMI ver1.1.Equipped with HDMI (High Definition Multimedia Interface), it realizes full digital transmission without degradation of image quality due to AD/DA conversion of video signal. This HDMI interface can transmit video signal with 10 bit processing as it is. Also, by adopting HDMI Version1.1, it can transmit not only video signal but also DTS, Dolby digital, multi-channel recorded DVD audio.Equipped with a 10-bit scaler IC developed in cooperation with Anchor Bay Technology Co., Ltd., it is possible to upconvert the video signal via the HDMI terminal to 720P, 1080i or Pure HD (1080P) and output it.The DV9600 also uses a 10-bit advanced progressive circuit for the I/P converter, which realizes full 10-bit video processing and transmission in all stages, in addition to transmission via the HDMI interface.Equipped with an HDMI resolution switch on the front panel, you can easily change the resolution of the video signal output from the HDMI terminal. You can switch the output resolution every time you press the button while HDMI is on. In addition, you can turn the HDMI output on / off with a long press of over 3 seconds.The 216 MHz video encoder achieves 8 x and 4 x oversampling for interlaced and progressive video, respectively, compared to 13.5 MHz standard resolution video. This enables high-precision D/A conversion, resulting in more natural contour reproduction. In addition, by applying 14-bit processing, the color reproducibility and luminance reproducibility of 4096 gradation for 12-bit processing have been expanded to 16384 gradation with 4 times accuracy.In addition, Analog Devices' Noise Shaped Video (NSV) technology shifts video noise components to unwanted bands and realizes high-precision images.The newly developed Chroma Error Compensation greatly eliminates the chroma error that occurs near the vertical edge of the color difference signal. In addition to DNR and CNR, which reduce noise in luminance and color signals, Block Noise Reduction (BNR), which reduces block-like noise characteristic of MPEG compression, and Mosquito Noise Reduction, which reduces flicker that occurs in the outline of the image, can be used for all types of discs.Equipped with an I. LINK (IEEE1394) connector, it enables digital transmission of not only linear PCM, Dolby Digital, and DTS, but also DVD audio and SACD multi-channel audio.When used in combination with the AV Amp SR9600, the Jitter Free Transfer System (JFTS), which takes advantage of I. LINK's bi-directional nature, operates, enabling higher sound quality playback. This adjusts the data read speed of the DV9600 according to the amount of data stored in the memory buffer of the SR9600. This eliminates the effect of jitters and realizes high-quality transmission.The audio circuit board uses 6-channel equal-quality HDAM. sections.title: MARANTZ SA-1
sections.overview: The first Marantz Super Audio CD player developed by carefully selected parts including the D/A converter of the highest level of precision.By using two 1-bit dual D/A converter DAC7 (TDA1547) per channel (four D/A converters), D/A conversion of DSD (direct stream digital) signals with sampling frequency 64 times that of CD is realized.An 8 x oversampling digital filter DF7 (TDA1307) is used A) is used to convert CD music signals with a sampling frequency of 44.1 kHz into bitstream data, which is passed to the 4-tap D/A converter section.The audio circuit uses a twin-backed dual HDAM (High-Speed Voltage Amplification Module), a high-end device originally developed by Marantz. With a high shield structure that minimizes the effects of heat, vibration, and electromagnetic waves, the HDAM realizes stable performance. The twin-packed HDAM achieves an ideal high slew rate and low impedance.The main power transformer in the power supply section is a super-ring-core toroidal transformer with a copper-plated shield cover. This transformer reduces the leakage flux level to about 1 / 10 and has a large capacity of 80 VA, providing ample regulation.In addition, a dedicated transformer is provided to supply power to the fluorescent display tube. In addition to data display of the display tube, the heater power can be turned off, and other noise shielding measures are taken.Specially selected block Chemicon is used for the power supply, and carefully selected parts such as machined RCA gold plated pin jack, gold plated balanced output terminal and detachable AC cord are used.To eliminate external vibration and internal resonance, zinc die-cast is used for the mechanism and its base chassis, and aluminum die-cast is used for the mechanical loader tray.In addition, as a measure to shut out radiation noise generated from the servo system of the mechanism, a copper-plated shield cover is adopted.It uses a base plate of 6.4 mm thick copper-plated steel and 6.7 kg weight. It firmly fixes the die-casting mechanism and at the same time, it reduces vibration, resonance and resonance from inside and outside by high rigidity.A 5 mm thick aluminum top cover is used for the top cover, and the casing is structured without screws from the front, top and side surfaces.It supports all chSACD discs (single-layer, dual-layer, and hybrid discs) and can play 2-channel discs recorded with a DST signal, as well as CDs and CD-R discs.Aluminum top remote controller is included.

sections.title: MARANTZ SA-11S1
sections.overview: SACD player SACD player developed as a reference player.It uses a new premium design that completely replaces the conventional Marantz design.This design is based on the basic concept of expression by light which is not limited only by shape and arrangement. In addition to the front panel of solid aluminum 3 piece construction, aluminum side panel which firmly supports the inside is adopted.It is equipped with Marantz original PEC (Phase Error Compensation) circuit using 24 bitDSP, and realizes flat characteristics of phase delay.In addition, this DSP achieves 8 x oversampling and 1st order noise shaper.Equipped with a digital filter 3-mode switching function, both SACD and CD can switch the most suitable digital filter for the system to 3-mode. In addition, the DC filter and noise shaper can be turned ON/OFF during CD playback.For CD playback, Filter1 is a filter with an original slow roll-off feature that creates a performance image characteristic of analog records and a rich, smooth, deep sound field, while Filter2 is a filter with a slow roll-off feature that realistically reproduces the mid-low to mid-range range.Filter3 is a filter with standard sharp roll-off characteristics. This filter reproduces the coefficient of SAA7220PB, a digital filter with 4 times operation adopted in CD-94/CD-95/CD-95SE, and has 8 times operation. Compared with Filter1/2, the sound is sharp.ON/OFF of the noise shaper and DC filter can be selected for each of the three filters.The noise shaper is a digital feedback, but you can check the difference in the gloss of the sound by turning it ON/OFF. In general, turning it OFF reduces the measurement characteristics, but it expresses the gloss of the sound.The DC filter cuts out sound below 1.7 Hz. Turning the DC filter OFF provides a more natural sound field.During SACD playback, Filter1 is a direct mode that does not filter DSD data, so it faithfully reproduces the original source.Filter2 filters and attenuates the portion of DSD data exceeding 100 kHz. In addition, by making the operation in the DAC asymmetric, the resolution of the DAC is given priority and the multi-level can be operated at up to 40 multi-level.Filter3 filters and attenuates the portion of DSD data exceeding 100 kHz. The operation in the DAC is 23 multi-level, fully symmetric operation. This filter has the best characteristics when combined with the I/V conversion in the latter stage.The D/A conversion section is equipped with two SM5866AS DACs manufactured by NPC Corporation.This DAC performs 12 times of oversampling internally at the PCM input, and converts 96 times of the total signal, including 8 times of the input signal, into 23 levels by the third noise shaper function, greatly reducing residual quantization noise from the audio signal band to the high frequency band.It has a direct mode that does not pass the internal digital filter when the DSD signal is input, and a Route 3 that attenuates the quantization noise of the DSD in the digital domain through a FIR type digital filter and outputs the current with a 23-40 level DAC.In addition, there is an internal register, and the input data is always written in the word clock and system clock which are compared in phase, and it is accurately read out to be jitter-free.It is input to the HDAM construction of the triple stage configuration output from D/AC.The I/V conversion section is equipped with a discrete I/V conversion circuit composed of HDAM.By directly coupling the current output of the DAC with the HDAM, we aim to improve the small signal loss that does not appear in the physical characteristics.A discrete HDAM circuit is used for the LPF after I/V conversion, and a current feedback type HDAM circuit is used for the output circuit to achieve a low impedance and low noise.The output is not only unbalanced but also full balanced analog output using XLR terminal. It is composed of current feedback type HDAM circuit similar to audio output to ensure the same output impedance and performance as unbalanced output.The block capacitor used in the power supply section is a custom Marantz product developed through repeated trial manufacture and trial listening. The power transformer is a super-ring toroidal transformer with OFC winding. The case is filled with a high-density material to prevent the vibration of the transformer from affecting sound quality.We use high-quality audio parts such as Schottky barrier diodes and mica capacitors for the rectifying circuit of the audio power supply.It is equipped with a digital output whose data is crystal relocked by the master clock.In addition, the SA-11S1 automatically stops the digital output in order to eliminate the effect on SACD playback. In addition, the digital output can be turned off during CD playback.Uses brass block machined gold-plated analog terminal.A mechanism module developed in-house by Marantz is used for the mechanism part.A stabilizer is mounted on the upper surface of the mechanism to increase rigidity.A   5 ppm high-precision type crystal is placed near the DAC to supply the optimum clock to the DAC with high precision.System remote control is included.

As the second SACD multi-channel player, this SACD player inherits the technology of high-end machines.Multi-channel playback of SACD is supported.This is the first SACD multi-channel player to use the current feedback HDAM (High-Speed Voltage Amplification Module) circuit for all channels of audio output. It also uses a discrete current feedback amplifier for its filter amplifier.As with the SA-12S1, a copper plate is added to the base of the multi-channel output terminal to achieve ground 0 impedance between the terminals. F/25V) developed through repeated trial listening.The headphone output circuit is a discrete configuration equipped with a high-speed current buffer amplifier with high drive capability.The chassis structure uses a double-layered chassis and the bottom chassis uses 1.6 mm thick steel plate (1.3 kg) to eliminate vibration.The LPF switch allows you to switch between Custom all (wide-band playback of all channels), which is effective when listening on a SACD-compatible system, and Standard all, which is used when listening on a conventional system.Equipped with a display off function, it can suppress pulse noise generated from the fluorescent display tube and prevent the influence of noise.You can view the TEXT information used for SACD and CD disks.In combination with an external timer, you can specify the track you want to listen to and play it on a timer.In addition to the gold model, there were limited 100 black models.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: MARANTZ CD-25
sections.overview: This is a Philips Marantz CD player with a sound quality design similar to the high-end model.Equipped with a 4 x oversampling Z filter.The Z-Filter, which consists of a digital filter that oversamples the sampling frequency (44.1 khz) to 176.4 khz, four times the sampling frequency, and a third order Bessel filter with excellent phase characteristics, ensures excellent phase characteristics. At the same time, the pass band is expanded to 30 khz to improve transient response characteristics.The D/A converter is a 2 dac type that uses dedicated D/A converters for both left and right sides, and achieves 0 phase rotation.A single-beam pickup with a simple structure and excellent detection capability is driven by a fully dynamic balanced arm.In order to further improve its performance, the design of the laser pickup itself has been completely redesigned and a new optical system has been adopted. At the same time, we have succeeded in reducing its size.By using Philips' proprietary replica technology, the surface of the objective lens is coated with a 10-micron aspherical film, and the optical system is composed of two lenses. This eliminates the focus shift caused by spherical aberration and provides a more accurate and stable pickup.In addition, the focusing mechanism, which used to be MM (Moving Magnet) type, is composed of MC (Moving Coil) type, which eliminates pickup malfunction caused by disk failure.The entire CD drive mechanism is mounted in a completely floating structure.The tray lid, which used to be integrated with the tray, is also installed independently, and the CD drive mechanism including the tray is separated from the chassis and floated to reduce vibration and resonance.We have developed and installed the CD-drive mechanism "CDM-2", which fully adopts "high-density glass wool plastic", a material used for medical devices.While striving to reduce weight, the resonance frequency has also been reduced.It is equipped with a random access program function of up to 20 songs.Equipped with a skip play function of up to 99 songs, you can easily find the song you want to listen to.Equipped with an index play function.It uses 3-speed search which can change speed in 3 stages.Equipped with a 2-way display that switches and displays the number of the music being played and the elapsed time.

At the same time, the pass band is expanded to 30 khz to improve transient response characteristics.The D/A converter is a 2 dac type that uses dedicated D/A converters for both left and right sides, and achieves 0 phase rotation.The ultra-compact laser pickup is completely driven by a dynamic balance type arm.The optical system of the pickup has been completely changed by original replica technology and MC-type focusing mechanism.The entire CD drive mechanism is mounted in a completely floating structure.The tray lid, which used to be integrated with the tray, is also installed independently, and the CD drive mechanism including the tray is separated from the chassis and floated to reduce vibration and resonance.We have developed and installed the CD-drive mechanism "CDM-2", which fully adopts "high-density glass wool plastic", a material used for medical devices.While striving to reduce weight, the resonance frequency has also been reduced.Equipped with Marantz Synchro REC function.When combined with a cassette deck, recording start can be controlled with the play switch of the CD-45.The CD-45 playback can be controlled by remote control in combination with remote control transmitter RMC-15, audio timer AT-333AV and tuner ST-463.When combined with a model equipped with the Marantz bus system function, the selector automatically switches to the CD position just by pressing the play switch of the CD-45.It is equipped with functions such as random access program, skip play, index play, repeat all songs / repeat program, 3-step speed search, display switching, etc.

sections.overview: A CD player developed by taking over the technology and know-how of high-end machines.The D/A converter uses TDA1541A with high accuracy and high linearity at low level. sections.title: MARANTZ CD-65
sections.overview: This CD player was developed based on the technology developed by the Philips Marantz Group and by investing more advanced technology.Equipped with a Z-filter consisting of a 4 x oversampling digital filter and a third order Bessel filter.The CD-65 inherits the basic configuration of the Z-filter, but it also incorporates the world's first 16-bit 4-times oversampling LSI as a D/A converter in place of the conventional LSI. In addition, newly developed LSIs for digital filters and PLL demodulation circuits before D/A conversion are introduced, and the decoder circuit is integrated into a 3-chip LSI.The built-in 16-bit 4 x oversampling LSI is a 16-bit D/A converter operating at 176.4 kHz. Moreover, it adopts a 2D/A converter system with L/R-independent dedicated channels in one chip. It features a phase characteristic of 4 x oversampling and a wide bandwidth, while at the same time expanding the dynamic range to obtain excellent characteristics.The mechanism is equipped with a CD-drive mechanism CDM-2 that uses new materials and new optical systems and pursues miniaturization, weight reduction, and non-vibration.The CDM-2 uses high-density glass-wool plastic, which is used in medical devices and precision equipment, for its mechanical components such as sub-chassis and swing arm. This reduces weight and reduces resonance frequency.The optical system uses Philips proprietary replica technology to coat the surface of the objective lens with a 10-micron non-spherical wave coating. The optical system consists of only two lenses (five lenses in the conventional system), eliminating spherical aberration caused by spherical lenses.In addition, the focusing mechanism has been improved from the conventional MM type to the MC type, and the weight has been reduced from magnet to coil to realize quick tracking.In order to eliminate adverse effects due to vibration and resonance, the resonance of the CD-drive mechanism CDM-2 itself is driven, and the CDM-2 is mounted in a completely floating structure.The tray lid, which had been integrated with the tray in the past, has been made independent, and the entire CD drive mechanism including the tray has been separated from the chassis and floated.Equipped with a digital output terminal.It is equipped with direct play, random access program of up to 20 songs, pancreas ticket play of up to 99 songs, index play, 3 speed search and repeat function.It is equipped with 3-way time display and headphone port with volume.

sections.title: MARANTZ CD-75
sections.overview: A high-performance CD player based on technologies such as a 4 x oversampling digital filter and a left-right independent 2D/A converter.While maintaining the basic configuration of the "Z-Filter", which is composed of a 4 x over-sampling digital filter and a 3rd order Bessel filter, the D/A converter is equipped with a 16-bit 4 x over-sampling LSI instead of the conventional LSI in order to improve performance.We have also introduced newly developed LSIs for digital filters and PLL demodulation circuits before D/A conversion, so that the decoder circuit can be integrated into a 3-chip LSI.The CD drive uses a newly improved CDM-2 that is compact, lightweight, and vibration-free.The sub-chassis, swing arm, and other CD drive mechanical components are made of high-density glass-wool plastic, which is used in medical and precision equipment. This reduces weight and reduces resonance frequency.In addition, using Philips' proprietary replica technology, the surface of the objective lens is coated with a 10-micron nonspherical film, and the optical system consists of two lenses, eliminating spherical aberration that cannot be avoided with spherical lenses.In addition, the focusing mechanism has been improved from the conventional MM (moving magnet) type to MC (moving coil) type to enable quick tracking.The CDM-2 is mounted in a completely floating structure, and the tray lid, which was integrated with the tray, is also separated, and the entire CD drive mechanism including the tray is separated from the chassis and floats.Equipped with a digital output.Remote control (RMC-75) with 10 keys is included.Equipped with a multi-display that centrally displays three types of time information : total time, elapsed time, and remaining time, track amber, and index number.When combined with a Marantz / Synchro / Rec compatible cassette deck (SD565, SD-74, etc.), you can control the recording start with the play button of the CD-75.Equipped with a headphone port with volume.With the direct play function, when you press the play button, the disc tray closes and play starts automatically.Features include a random access program of up to 20 songs, skip play of up to 99 songs, index play, 3-speed search and repeat function.

sections.title: MARANTZ CD-80
sections.overview: This CD player was created by introducing the latest devices such as S1 type D/A converter and CDM-1MkII mechanism.The D/A converter uses the S1 type TDA1541A-S1 with a crown mark, which is carefully selected from the latest A version. The CD-80 uses a 16-bit 4 x over-sampling digital filter to convert the signal into an analog signal using an L/R-independent S1 device. This eliminates harmful digital components such as 0 cross distortion.The mechanism section is equipped with a CDM-1MkII mechanism that employs a robust die-cast frame and a long-life brushless Hall motor. In addition, the entire mechanism is made completely floating with dampers and springs to achieve excellent loading performance.In addition, unlike normal linear tracking, it uses a swing arm system with weights placed at the rear, making it possible to read signals stably at all times.Access time is further improved by adopting newly developed servo ICs for the servo circuit.The main chassis is solid die-cast, the top is non-magnetic aluminum plate and the bottom is 3-mm-thick metal plate. Together with die-cast side panels, the Antivibrating Unified Frame (AUF) structure is unique.It also uses a heavy-weight aluminum insulator.A large transformer is used for the power supply and a separate structure is used to supply power to each of the servo system, analog system, digital system, and display independently to prevent mutual interference between circuits.In addition, the Celafine type capacitor significantly reduces the impedance of the power supply. In addition, the circuit parts are strictly selected, including specially made ones, and the copper thickness of the signal path is doubled where necessary to improve sound quality.Since a DC coupling configuration is adopted in the output stage and no capacitor is required to cut off the DC component, there is no signal degradation.It is equipped with a unique FTS function that can program 126 discs semi-permanently (as a program of 5 songs per disc).It is equipped with functions such as a 20-track program, five edit functions, random play, and AMS (Automatic Music Scan) that plays songs sequentially.It has a dimmer function that can adjust the brightness of the display.In addition to fixed and variable analog outputs, it is equipped with optical and coaxial digital outputs.Equipped with a 35-key full remote control. Dimmer and AMS are remote-only functions.Available in 2 color variations, gold and black.

sections.title: MARANTZ CD-84
sections.overview: In order to improve sound quality, stability, and operability, a CD player was developed by developing original technology and investing a number of know-how and technologies.Equipped with a Z filter that is an improved and developed digital filter.The Z-filter consists of a digital filter, a D/A converter and a low-pass filter. The Z-filter oversamples the sampling frequency by a factor of four, so that 44.1 kHz becomes 176.4 kHz, which is processed by a low-pass filter with gentle characteristics. This eliminates the deterioration of phase characteristics and transient response characteristics caused by the high-order filter.The low-pass filter of the Z filter uses a Bessel filter with excellent phase characteristics in addition to the low order of 3rd order. It ensures good phase characteristics up to high frequencies, and at the same time, expands the pass band to 30 kHz to improve transient response characteristics.In addition, a left-right independent 2D/A converter is used for D/A conversion to prevent phase rotation.Swing arm pickup is used for the pickup part.The swing-arm pickup has a structure with a laser pickup at the tip and a counterweight at the rear to achieve a dynamic balance, enabling a stable pickup trace at all times.The world's smallest semiconductor laser pickup is used in the pickup section.Through miniaturization, the components of the pickup have been simplified, and the optical system components have been reduced to two lenses and one beam splitter, thereby maintaining high assembly accuracy and improving reliability.In addition, the miniaturization of the entire pickup makes it possible to achieve a high-efficiency design that effectively uses only the central portion of the laser beam.A unique swing arm pickup is mounted on an aluminum die-cast base to suppress external vibration and microvibration of the rotating system and improve stability.The power supply section is equipped with a large transformer and a large-capacity capacitor. In addition, the power supply for circuits that generate switching noise, such as audio circuits, digital circuits, servo circuits, and digital displays, is separated, and a completely independent power supply is used to suppress noise.For each stage, we use parts that have been learned through hearing.In addition, the earth point, an important factor in determining sound quality, also determines the best focus by hearing.It is equipped with a random access program and a delete program for up to 24 songs, an auto music scan for playing only the intro, a head-start function, a skip function, a back-stop function, a repeat function, and a music standby function.Equipped with a large display capable of displaying digital display + program indicator.Equipped with digital interface terminal.It can be operated from a remote location by the attached dedicated remote controller.It is also compatible with the Marantz Bus System that carries out remote control and easy operation using a dedicated microcomputer. Remote control is possible by using the audio timer AT333R together with the remote control transmitter RMC-10.

sections.title: MARANTZ CD-94
sections.overview: This CD player was developed based on the development results and research results from the first CD player, the CD-63 to the LHH2000.Equipped with TDA1541, a 16-bit D/A converter LSI that operates with 4 x oversampling, all digital decoders are made to be 16-bit. The TDA1541 is equipped with two D/A converters for Lch and Rch in the chip LSI, eliminating the phase shift between right and left.The mechanism part is tuned up with the CDM-1 mechanism which is also used for professional CD players.By separating and separating the pre-amplifier for the laser signal which had been mounted in the mechanism in the past, the pre-amplifier circuit is freed from the microvibration of the rotary system. Furthermore, the circuit itself is also pursued in large scale and sound quality.In addition, reinforcing ribs have been added to the mechanism unit by aluminum die-casting to increase rigidity.The digital circuit, audio circuit, servo circuit, microcomputer and display circuit are each composed of independent circuit boards. The layout is designed to eliminate noise while suppressing mutual interference.The power supply section uses a large transformer and a custom electrolytic capacitor of 68,000 ? Fx2. The secondary winding of the power supply transformer is divided into four sections for digital circuits, audio circuits, servo circuits, and display circuits. These sections are independent of each other to prevent noise from the power supply section. The regulator circuit is also made discrete to reduce noise from the power supply section itself.A die-cast chassis is used for the chassis and combined with an integrally molded aluminum pull-out top cover to increase the weight and rigidity of the body.CD Filing Bank Contains FTS (Treasure Track Selection) for permanent storage of programs, automatically determines which CDs are programmed, and plays the stored programs on each CD.Almost all operations are possible with the included wireless remote control.Equipped with shuffle play shuffle play, program playback of up to 20 songs, repeat mode of FTS / shuffle / program / A-B / one song / all songs, AMS function to play the heads of songs one after another, timer play, etc.It has a headphone port.The digital output terminal is coaxial with the optical output terminal.

sections.overview: This is a limited model aiming for top quality as the gold version of CD-94.The D/A converter is equipped with a 16-bit D/A converter LSI, TDA1541, which operates with 4-times oversampling unique to the CD developer, and all digital decoders are 16-bit.In addition, the TDA1541 is an L-R independent dual DAC equipped with a D/A converter exclusively for Lch and Rch. Therefore, phase shift between right and left is eliminated up to ultra-high frequencies, and wide-band characteristics and dynamic range up to 30 kHz are achieved.The CDM-1 mechanism used in the CD drive mechanism is tuned up and mounted.The possibility of sound quality degradation due to vibration is eliminated by improving rigidity by adding a reinforcing rib and installing a pre-amplifier for laser signal separately.Equipped with a digital output that can be digitally transmitted to a separate-type D/A converter such as the CDA-94.The optical output and 75 ohm coaxial output are standardized by the Digital Audio Interface format and are compatible with all D/A converters with input terminals of the same format.The circuit layout takes into account the interference between digital and analog circuits and eliminates noise.As a countermeasure against vibration and resonance, we have adopted a heavy die cast for the chassis, a 3 mm thick steel plate for the bottom plate, and Portland cement is filled in the space inside the large insulator.In addition to the CD Filing Bank FTS, which can permanently store 150 CDs, it is equipped with functions such as shuffle play by remote control.

sections.title: MARANTZ CD-95
sections.overview:
180,000 (released in 1988)  164,000 (around 1989)

A CD player that brings together the technology and know-how of CD developers to realize a high degree of perfection.The D/A conversion circuit consists of an original LSI (TDA-1541A S-1) which was originally developed and improved by Philips Marantz.This TDA 1541 A S-1 is a selective type that is even more selected from Philips' latest Device A version and has a crown mark engraved along with the model number.This guarantees 0.5 LSB in the case of a small signal and 1 LSB in the case of a normal signal over the whole temperature range.The D/A conversion configuration consists of two D/A converters per channel and a push-pull D/A conversion A conversion method is adopted.The two converters are a combination of positive and negative phases, through which the waveform is synthesized, and at the same time the in-phase component is canceled and the even-order low distortion, including hum and very low-frequency noise, is cancelled out and greatly reduced.In order to maximize the performance of the single CD, the 12 cm CD and 8 cm CD are detected by the sensor, the range of servo operation is switched by the circuit constant, and the operating point is set to be the midpoint.The drive mechanism uses the CDM-1 type developed by Philips Marantz.It is a single-beam swing-arm pickup developed from an idea different from the conventional linear tracking system. The lens is made of Rodenstock glass. It has less aberration, excellent temperature characteristics, and improved pickup capability.In addition, a samarium-cobalt magnet is used for the linear motor that is the power source, and together with the servo system that controls the swing arm, a smooth and reliable bit and race is realized.In addition, a die-cast base has been adopted to improve rigidity, and the influence of external vibration, etc. is suppressed.The power supply consists of a large transformer comparable to a power amplifier and an electrolytic capacitor of 68,000 ? Fx2. In particular, new materials are used for the electrolytic capacitor, which is carefully selected to emphasize sound quality.The secondary winding of the power transformer is divided into a digital circuit, an audio circuit and a display circuit to make them independent.The regulator circuit also uses a discrete configuration to eliminate noise associated with the power supply.The chassis is made of die-cast material and has a solid sandwich structure consisting of die-cast side panels and 3-mm-thick bottom plates to reduce vibration.In addition, Marantz's unique ARC (Aluminum Faft Ceiling) structure is adopted for the top cover, and by using a 3-piece structure with raft cut, strength is improved and vibration mode diffusion is attempted.In addition, the pre-amplifier for the laser signal, which is normally mounted in the mechanism, is isolated from the rotating system to reduce the effect of vibration.The digital circuit, audio circuit, servo circuit, microcomputer and display circuit are designed to be independent on the circuit layout in order to prevent vibration and harmful interference.Equipped with two digital outputs, optical and coaxial.In addition to the normal random access program (20 songs), it is equipped with a filing bank "FTS". Once the program is stored in memory, it can be filed semi-permanently even when the power is turned off.Equipped with remote control as standard.

sections.title: MARANTZ CD-99SE
sections.overview: Special edition CD player developed based on CD-95Various changes have been made such as the adoption of toroidal transformer.The CD-drive mechanism uses CDM-1, which was developed by Phillips-Marantz Group.By mounting a one beam swing arm pickup on a die-cast base and controlling the swing arm with a servo system, which is completely different from the three beam linear tracking system, a smooth and reliable bit trace is achieved.The D/A conversion circuit consists of an original LSI "TDA1541AS-1" developed by Phillips-Marantz Group.It uses a carefully selected microchip from the A version of Philips' latest device at the time, and guarantees accuracy of 0.5 LSB for small signal and 1 LSB for normal level over the whole temperature range.We have also adopted a push-pull D/A conversion method using two D/A converters per channel, which successfully eliminates harmful components that cause sound quality degradation.The power supply section has an independent transformer dedicated to the FL display, and other parts are completely separated by supplying them with a toroidal transformer. Furthermore, the toroidal transformer separates the winding for each part to prevent noise from entering the audio circuit.We have also introduced high-capacity electrolytic capacitors made of new materials.The addition to the structure of the mechanism itself which is resistant to vibration, the vibration countermeasure is thoroughly strengthened by side die-casting, 3 mm thick top cover, 3 mm thick bottom plate, and the sandwich structure realizes no vibration and no resonance.In addition, the copper-plated chassis prevents high-frequency waves from entering other devices.All output terminals are gold-plated and equipped with one analog output, one coaxial digital output, and one optical output.It is equipped with functions such as the "FTS" function which allows semi-permanent filing even if the power is turned off once the program is stored, and 20 songs random program.

sections.title: MARANTZ CD650
sections.overview: CD player with 16 bit 4 x over-sampling digital filter and CD filing bank FTS.Equipped with a unique Z-filter centered around a 4 x oversampling digital filter and a left-right independent 2D/A converter.In the CD650, a newly developed 16-bit 4 x over-sampling LSI is incorporated into this Z-filter. By operating at 176.4 kHz, this Z-filter achieves excellent phase characteristics inherent in the 4 x over-sampling system and high transient response characteristics with a pass band of 30 kHz. In addition, a third order Bessel filter with excellent phase characteristics is used as the low-pass filter after D/A conversion.The D/A converter employs a 2-DCAC system with dedicated D/A converters on the left and right sides, reducing the occurrence of phase shift. In addition to two D/A converters contained in a single chip LSI, newly developed LSIs for a digital filter and a PLL demodulation circuit are introduced, and stability is enhanced by integrating a decoder circuit into three chips.The mechanism uses CDM-2, which is an improved version of our original swing arm mechanism, and the floating structure reduces the influence of vibration and resonance.While inheriting the basic design of the swing arm 1-beam laser pickup, the CDM-2 is a completely new material and optical system. It uses high-density glass wool + Tic to realize weight reduction and low resonance frequency.In addition, the pickup unit has been made smaller and more precise by introducing a unique replica technology (aspherical coating) and MC-type focusing mechanism.In addition to the normal analog output terminal, it is equipped with a Meister output that takes into account the phase characteristics in the audio band and the high-frequency characteristics of the analog master CD based on musical characteristics.In addition, a digital output terminal is mounted.It is equipped with newly developed CD filing bank FTS, and programs can be stored in memory by FTS.The FTS automatically determines which CDs are programmed and plays the program stored on each CD. The CD is determined by a unique ID code. The ID code combines the TOC data recorded on all CDs and can be automatically input simultaneously with the program.The memory of FTS can be up to 155 songs, assuming that five songs are programmed on one CD. The memory element is EEPROM (2 kbyte), and the program can be either track, time or index and can be programmed up to 20 songs on one CD.It is equipped with a multi-display which displays the operation of each function such as FTS, track, index, elapsed time and remaining time in a centralized manner.It is equipped with a random access program of up to 20 songs, skip play, scan function, 5-mode repeat, auto pause, copy pause to insert a 4-second blank between songs, and 3-speed search.Equipped with a headphone port equipped with volume.There was a side wood as an option.It comes with a remote control that allows you to control most functions including random access from your hand.

sections.title: MARANTZ CDR-1
sections.overview: This commercial recorder was announced as the first Marantz CD recorder.In the recording section, analog audio signals are converted into digital signals by a 1-bit A/D converter, converted by CIRC and EFM encoders, and sent to the CD-R mechanism. Digital signals are also converted directly by encoders, enabling digital to digital recording.The CD-R mechanism block has a function for recording in addition to reading the signal for reproduction, especially for changing the laser power for reading and recording, decoding the signal from the preform track of the CD-R disc, and electronics for speed control.The D/A converter is equipped with SAA7350, a bit stream type D/A converter, and high reliability is enhanced by using high-quality parts such as die-cast chassis with high damping effect.Built-in recording functions include automatic power calibration, which uses the PCM area of a CD-R disc to automatically set the laser power required for disc recording, automatic track increment, which automatically increments the track number of songs after a specified period of silence, manual track input, which is manually set without automatically determining the track delimiter, automatic space mute, which automatically creates approximately three seconds of silence between tracks, and synchronous recording, which enables synchronous recording through a remote connection with Marantz / Philips D BUS.As playback functions, it is equipped with program playback, shuffle playback, repeat playback and auto-scan function.When playing back a CD-R disc that has not been fixed up, it has a skip function that instructs it to skip unnecessary parts of the recorded signal and treats them as if they do not exist. It also has an unskip function that restores the skipped parts.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: MARANTZ CDR640
sections.overview: This professional CD recorder was developed aiming at the highest level of CD recorder.It conforms to IEC60958 Type 1, an industrial standard, and has an AEX/EBU terminal.Equipped with ATL (Auto Track Level) function, it can be adjusted in 13 steps of 5 db in the range of -70dB to -10dB.This feature can be turned on and off as needed and can be set to match the state of the source to help prevent false recognition during track increments.A memory buffer of up to 4 seconds (1 mb) is reserved for Q subcode processing.The ADT (Audio Delay Time) function adjusts the recording start timing in 16 steps from 0 to up to 4 seconds to prevent audio data from being truncated.Equipped with a copy protection function, you can choose from 3 types : OFF (unlimited copy possible), ON (SCMS compatible, unlimited copy prohibited), and HCO (complete copy prohibited).With built-in preset keys, it is possible to reach the desired setting change mode by simply pressing both the main body and the remote control one by one to improve operability.Control I/O terminal (D-sub9-pin, parallel) is mounted.Equipped with a CASC ON function that allows digital input to pass out to other devices. Up to three devices can be cascade-connected.Equipped with analog input sensitivity switching function, switching of + 4dBu/-10dBu is possible.Analog balanced input / output terminals are mounted.This connector is a European type with #1 ground, #2 hot (+), and #3 cold (-).Equipped with a TOC erase function, you can erase only the TOC of a finalized CD-RW disc and record additional music or edit the final music.Equipped with a through monitor function, it can be used as a stand-alone AD/DA and sampling rate converter.It is equipped with an emphasis setting mode function. In the case of digital source, the preemphasis status is copied to the disc as it is. In the case of analog source, ON/OFF can be set depending on whether preemphasis is applied or not.Equipped with a sampling rate converter that supports 12 to 56 kHz.Two modes are installed : SRC OFF, which lights the indicator when a source other than 44.1 kHz is detected and automatically switches to SRC mode, and SRC ON, which always activates the SRC function regardless of the source type.If the source is 44.1 kHz (  100 ppm), a full copy can be made by turning OFF the SRC, so that data such as HDCD or DTS can be recorded as is.It is equipped with STP (Recording Stop Condition) function which stops recording automatically in Q subcode base or ATL base. If CD or MD is the source, it stops after about 3 seconds from the lead-out.Equipped with track increment function.For digital sources such as CD/MD/DAT, tracks are incremented based on the Q subcode ; for digital and analog sources without category codes, tracks are incremented after 2.7 seconds of silence (ATL) is detected.You can change the ATL configuration.Equipped with a CD sync function, synchronous recording is possible not only for digital sources with track ID but also for digital and analog sources without Q subcode.A wired remote control with a cord length of approximately 3m is included.With this remote control, various operations of the main body and numeric keypad operation are possible.EIA19-inch x2U rack mount size.

sections.title: MARANTZ DR6000
sections.overview: This is a Century Series CD recorder which pursues not only recording function but also sound quality.It is compatible with both CD-R and CD-RW formats.For the mechanism part, a vibration control structure mechanism using a die-cast is adopted as a countermeasure against vibration that affects recording and reproduction.Equipped with digital level and balance control, the level can be adjusted within a range of -63dB to + 6 dB during digital recording, and the balance can be adjusted in 100 steps each for left and right.Equipped with a sampling rate converter, digital signals from devices with different sampling frequencies, such as CS/BS and DAT, can be automatically converted to 44.1 kHz, the same frequency as CD, enabling recording from various devices.With the digital direct recording function, digital sources with a sampling frequency of 44.1 khz, such as CDs, can be recorded without a sampling rate converter, and HDCD and DTS CD can also be recorded.With built-in CD text input, erasure and editing functions, you can record album titles and artist names together with music. HDAM's shielding structure eliminates the influence of heat, vibration, and electromagnetic waves, and effectively increases the density and speed of playback sound.The D/A converter uses TDA1305, a Philips DAC that uses a bit stream method. The differential operation of the DAC circuits independent of L/R realizes high channel separation and reduction of harmonic distortion.An EI-type power transformer using an OFC (oxygen-free copper wire) is used for the power transformer, and a highly selected high-quality electrolytic capacitor is used.Uses gold-plated input / output terminals.SCMS is supported.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: MARANTZ MODEL1120
sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier designed to simplify the circuit and achieve a high-quality balance.All stages of the power amplifier section are directly connected with a differential amplifier circuit on the top.A perfect pair is created for the two stones of the differential amplifier stage, and these two stones are coupled into one to keep the same state thermally, and excellent characteristics are obtained in one stage.A diode is used for each part to achieve perfect temperature compensation, and a special air-core coil is used to prevent degradation of the distortion factor in the high-frequency. Thus, careful phase compensation is performed.The power transistor is a special product jointly developed by Marantz and Motorola.The protection circuit is the same type as the Model 500. If there is a leakage current to the speaker, the relay operates and turns OFF. In addition, the timing is shifted by the relay until the amplifier is fully operational in order to prevent the click sound caused by the instantaneous rush current when the switch is turned ON as well as muting.The power transistor is a current sensor type that controls the current of the complimentary service stage.And in case of overheating, the thermostat of the heat sinker is set to operate.The pre-section equalizer stage has a two stage configuration, with a differential-amplifier circuit at the top and a SEPP pure complimentary service circuit at the final stage.In addition, the feedback loop is completely directly connected, and two stages of negative feedback are applied.A capacitor of 1.0 ? F is inserted at the top of the differential circuit to cut off unnecessary high frequency components, and a resistor of 22M   is inserted to completely remove the click at the time of equalizer switching.The tone circuit is also a two stage direct-coupled type. It has a configuration with a differential amplifier circuit on the head and the last stage is held down by a   balance power supply. It goes up and down with selectivity in the negative feedback circuit. Normally, the two stages take the feedback of one stage and keep the input impedance large and the output impedance small.CR type is adopted for both low and high filter stages.The power supply for the preamplifier is a constant voltage power supply that also serves as a complete ripple filter for both the + and - sides.Almost all parts are put together on a total of six printed circuit boards, and all switches and rotary switches are printed circuit boards. In addition, there is no shield wire that is normally routed from the input terminal to the selector switch except for one location. This is a fundamental solution to the problem of noise caused by wiring, which is a problem in high-end machines.Instead of the usual wire wrapping method, a wire clamp is used to fix the lead wire. This structure allows each circuit board to be adjusted independently even later.For printed circuit boards, copper foils are coated to prevent corrosion and breakage.Switches are designed so that they can be switched at the place where they are really needed by lengthening the shaft, and the shortest connection is realized.The back side of the input terminal board is completely shielded with copper foil to prevent induction noise from the outside. In addition, a special contact relay made in Austria is used to prevent contamination with dust and eliminate contact.In addition, there is a space in the center of the inside that can hold 4 fist to avoid mutual interference.Equipped with a scope out terminal that can monitor the phase characteristics of the cartridge.Walnut cabinet and rack mount adapter were sold separately as an option.

sections.title: MARANTZ MODEL1150
sections.overview: This is a pre-main amplifier that has been polished over time with an emphasis on listening quality in addition to physical characteristics.All stages of the push-pull drive are L circuit directly connected to all stages of the push-pull drive. The output-stage uses the inverted Darlington method. complimentary serviceThe power supply unit capacitor uses an internal tandem with very small plus / minus capacitance deviation, reducing distortion in the high frequency range and improving stability.The equalizer amplifier section uses a 3-stage direct-coupled NF type circuit that uses differential amplification for the input.This circuit consists of a set of differential input transistors, a constant current source, a high-gain amplifier stage, and a stabilized + - power supply, allowing a wide range of cartridges to be used without overloading.In addition, 100% DC feedback improves amplifier stability.The tone amplifier section uses four transistors for each of the left and right channels, and consists of two stages of Darlington connection.This circuit can be adjusted in three stages (bass, mid and treble) by means of independent sliding knobs on the left and right sides. Moreover, the range of influence of the tone control can be shifted to 250 Hz or less in the low range and to 4 kHz in the high range by operating the turnover switch.Also, if the tone switch is turned out, the signal can bypass the tone control circuit and is connected to the pre-out while maintaining the flat characteristics.Equipped with high, low, and subsonic active filter circuits.When the front panel pushbutton is pressed, the corresponding filter element is connected to the feedback circuit of the amplifier, resulting in a roll-off of 12dB/oct at 10 Hz, 30 Hz and 9 kHz.A PEP (Pure Electronic Protection Device) circuit is used for the protection circuit to protect the power transistor from excessive current and voltage caused by a sudden load short-circuit. The protection circuit is also equipped with a temperature compensation circuit to ensure proper operation even under extreme temperature conditions. The control circuit elements are perfectly Darlington connected.In addition, there is a built-in speaker protection relay to protect the speakers, which is also a delay circuit that disconnects the switch for approximately four seconds after the power switch is turned on.There is also a dubbing jack on the front panel so you can connect it without removing it from the rack or shelf.When you plug in the Dubbing in jack, the Tape2in jack is automatically disconnected, and the Dubbing out jack and Tape2out jack are connected in parallel so that you can record to three tape recorders simultaneously and dubbing from Tape1 to one of the other and vice versa.In addition, any tape recorder can be monitored at any time by operating the monitor switch.The cabinet was sold separately and there were 2 types, mahogany and walnut.There was also an optional rack mount adapter.

sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier that pursues low TIM (transient intermodulation distortion) and transient intermodulation distortion.The power section is a pure complimentary service OCL parallel push-pull 3-stage Darlington circuit with a Marantz traditional DC-configuration, and uses low-noise elements specially made by Marantz.In addition, a differential amplification cascode bootstrap circuit using a low-noise specification FET is adopted in the first stage of this power amplifier to minimize temperature drift and time drift which are problems in DC amplifiers.As a result, we have obtained excellent phase characteristics and transmission capability over a wide band range from ultra-low to ultra-high frequencies. In addition, we have succeeded in putting the concept of Low TIM into practice by eliminating phase distortion in ultra-low frequencies and raising bare characteristics.Equipped with ESP circuit adopted by P510M.This ESP circuit instantaneously detects excessive output current and voltage or DC generation at the output terminal, and limits the signal to the driver transistor to a safe value to protect against overdrive and short circuit.Moreover, it detects frequency and time with instantaneous differential, and provides continuous protection without interrupting the program.In addition, it is equipped with a relay with a delay circuit (4 seconds) to prevent shock noise caused by power ON. In case of transistor accident, the speaker automatically disconnects.In actual program playback, the peak of the transient in a source such as direct cutting with a wide dynamic range may exceed the average level by + 10 dB to + 20 dB (10 to 100 times).It is equipped with a peak indicator that responds instantaneously to such peaks, making level adjustment easy and preventing clipping.The equalizer amplifier is a 5 tr configuration consisting of a differential input amplifier, a buffer amplifier and a low-current load A class amplifier with a specially designed low-noise element. It is a first stage differential 3-stage direct-coupled differential circuit.Equipped with a loudness contour, it is possible to fine-tune the low and high frequencies at low volume according to the characteristics of human ears, and to adjust the correction amount by the Fletcher Munson curve in 10 stages according to the volume.Equipped with Marantz's original tritone control mechanism that can control the MID range.The Tape Copy mechanism, which can copy from one tape deck to another and can also be monitored, is an independent circuit and can differentiate other sources individually.It uses a Bessel filter with excellent roll-off characteristics.A sharp roll-off curve of 18dB/oct. at 9 kHz and 15 Hz has been achieved and phase distortion has been successfully reduced.Equipped with a tone defeat that jumps the tone circuit and sets the frequency response to flat.Equipped with a DC/AC amplifier selection switch.Wooden cabinet is sold separately.
