V and a dynamic margin of 110 dB are achieved.It uses the world's first tri-circuit.This mechanism features two selector knobs laid out on the left side of the front panel. sections.title: MARANTZ PM-5
sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier capable of switching between pure class A and class AB.In addition to pure A-class 20W/ch, AB-class 80W/ch can be switched. Moreover, in order to raise the quality of AB-class to the level of pure A-class, a high-speed high-fT transistor with a high cut-off frequency of 90 MHz is adopted in the power stage, eliminating the switching distortion that is a defect of AB-class to the limit.The PM-5 adopts a complete push-pull DC amplifier configuration in all stages to eliminate TIM distortion from every corner of the amplifier, thereby improving the bare characteristics.Transient cross-modulation distortion and static characteristics are improved without applying a large amount of NFB.In order to improve the stable operation of the power transistor, a newly developed heat pipe system has been adopted for the heat radiation mechanism. Since heat is out of the circuit and cooled by a radiator, the transistor can be placed in an ideal position, simplifying the circuit and reducing distortion.The power supply section is equipped with a large-capacity capacitor developed for audio equipment and a compact high-power transformer filled with a special resin for heat resistance.The phono amplifier block is designed with low distortion and high S/N ratio by using transistors lavishly.In addition, a straight DC circuit connecting the phono amplifier directly to the power stage is incorporated to improve the quality of disc playback.In addition, the phono amplifier incorporates a high-precision MC head amplifier and subsonic circuit.The subsonic function works only for the equalizer to simplify other functions.The tone control is adjustable by   8 dB from 100 Hz to 10 kHz. The balance can be adjusted independently on the left and right sides. Moreover, the use of high precision volume realizes a flat response at the midpoint of the knob.It is also equipped with a loudness control that compensates for the low and high frequencies.The center of the front panel is equipped with a full-scale peak power meter.Unlike bar display, both pure A class and AB class LED display power as points, so clear and accurate output can be directly read.Under the meter, there are various functions such as a dubbing circuit that enables mutual recording from deck to deck, and a speaker selector switch that enables listening comparison between two speakers and simultaneous playback.

sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier equipped with QuarterA system.In QuaterA, the bias current is fixed until a certain power level (30W for PM-6a) is reached and the operation is fully pure class A. Fx2 that is carefully selected for sound quality.In addition, a heat pipe system with high heat radiation effect is adopted, and stable operation is obtained even in pure A class which consumes a large current.It is equipped with two phono inputs, of which Phono1 is equipped with 27k  , 47k   and 100k   MM load clock in addition to the MC head amplifier position.In addition, it is equipped with functions such as a tape copy switch that allows two decks to dub each other, two levels of loudness, and independent tone control on both sides.There was a mahogany cabinet sold separately.

sections.title: MARANTZ PM-11S1
sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier developed over 2 years as an integrated amplifier inheriting the concept of a separate amplifier.This item uses a new premium design that is different from the previous Marantz design.This design is based on the basic concept of expression by light which is not limited only by shape and arrangement, and uses the front panel of solid aluminum 3 piece construction and the aluminum side panel which firmly supports the inside.A low-noise LCD is used for the display, and the front panel controls are illuminated in blue.By reducing the impedance of the signal line with the linear control volume and HDAM SA2, and by reviewing the internal layout, channel separation at high frequencies has been improved by more than 10 dB.This improves not only channel separation between the left and right channels, but also channel separation between different amplifier stages.The power supply section and power block section are designed to be extremely low impedance. The instantaneous current supply capability has been improved by more than two times by using a substrate with a foil thickness of 70 microns, OFC extra-thick wiring material for the high-current section, high-speed power transistors and Schottky barrier diodes, and minimizing by reviewing the internal layout.It is equipped with HDAM SA2 which is an evolution of HDAM SA installed in SC-7S1/MA-9S1.The HDAM SA2 is a key module for voltage / current conversion of a current feedback amplifier. It is also suitable as a high-speed buffer amplifier. It is also a compact module because of the need to reduce the circuit area for high channel separation.The PM-11S1 is equipped with a current feedback phono amplifier, balance buffer amplifier, line buffer amplifier, volume amplifier, voltage amplifier, and power buffer amplifier that are composed of many HDAM SA2s.It follows the design concept of the SC-7S1 and is equipped with a dedicated input amplifier for all inputs.It is equipped with a current feedback type balance buffer amplifier using HDAM SA2 for the balance input, and is compatible with devices with a balance output.All line input terminals are equipped with line buffers using dedicated HDAM SA2 to prevent interference between each input source.The linear control volume developed in the SC-7S1 is used for the volume.This volume can be adjusted linearly between 0 and -100dB with an accuracy of   0.5 dB.The phono equalizer amplifier is equipped with a current feedback circuit for the first time as a Marantz.Both MM and MC cartridges are supported.The power amplifier section follows the design concept of the MA-9S1, and consists of two amplifiers of 11 dB voltage amplifier (voltage amplifier circuit) and 12.5 dB power buffer amplifier (power amplifier circuit).This prevents the back electromotive force from a speaker with a strong magnetic circuit from being fed back to the voltage amplification stage.A choke input power supply is used for the power supply for the input amplifier and the preamplifier, which handle small signals.This power supply consists of a high-capacity capacitor (15,000 ? Fx2) combined with a Marantz original hybrid transformer with a choke coil set in the ring core, and completely eliminates harmonic noise generated in the rectifier circuit and high-frequency noise from the outside.The power supply section employs a large super-ring toroidal transformer with a shield case with a built-in choke coil, a low-foil magnification low-impedance capacitor (18,000 ? Fx2), and a Schottky barrier diode to support a power buffer with an instantaneous current supply capacity of approximately 50A.Equipped with F. C. B. S (Floating Control Bus System).This function synchronizes up to four PM-11S1s through high-speed bi-directional communication. It supports complete bi-amplifier and multi-channel.System remote control is included.

sections.title: MARANTZ PM-14
sections.overview: This is a pre-main amplifier that has been developed by gathering the know-how of amplifier production that has been cultivated up to now such as SC-5, PM-16, PM-17, etc.The power amplifier section uses the latest Marantz current feedback type.In this method, phase compensation is reduced by lowering the feedback impedance, and an extremely high-speed amplifier can be realized. In addition, the amplifier is stable against load fluctuations, and the output choke coil, which is harmful to sound quality, can be removed. This is also advantageous in terms of S/N.The first stage is voltage-amplified by a high-speed adjustable HDAM, followed by an I/V converter using a current mirror circuit after impedance conversion, and connected to a 3-stage Darlington power amplifier that can obtain a DC amplification factor. The output stage is single-push-pull with a Pc = 200W multi-emitter bipolar transistor.A 100% DC feedback is applied to the first stage, and by adjusting the DC offset of the adjustable HDAM, the DC servo due to active elements, which is a problem in S/N, etc., can be eliminated.The power transistor is mounted on a large heat sink with sufficient space through a copper cover that serves as both vibration isolation and shielding.The preamp section uses Marantz's original 4-channel active volume system.In this method, a volume is also inserted into the NF circuit of the preamplifier and linked with the input volume to continuously change the gain of the preamplifier. Since the residual noise of the amplifier is mainly generated at the first stage, the residual noise can be reduced by changing the total gain. On the PM-14, the preamplifier section has a full gain of 20 dB, but the gain can be reduced by about 14 dB, which improves the S/N ratio.The circuit configuration uses a low-noise, high-slew rate adjustable HDAM, and the output section is equipped with a bipolar transistor diamond SEPP buffer to sufficiently reduce the output impedance. The preamplifier section can also be used independently.The volume uses a die-cast housing for the motor clutch, and the shaft uses a Duque product made of brass, which is superior in sound quality.The tone control amplifier uses an active filter type that uses a Bar Brown high-speed OP amplifier.With this method, even when the low and high frequencies are raised, the rise of unwanted frequencies (ultra-low and ultra-high frequencies), which is harmful to the speaker, is suppressed, and there is no waviness in the frequency response in the flat position.It is equipped with an NF-type phono equalizer amplifier for each MC/MM cartridge.The first stage uses the latest adjustable HDAM (high-speed voltage amplification module) with low-noise FET, and the output uses a high-gain, high-slew rate audio OP amplifier to ensure low output impedance and sufficient gain for the MC input.The power supply uses a 450 VA super-ring core toroidal transformer with high efficiency and low magnetic flux leakage. In addition, it is equipped with two large stress-free low-double foil filter capacitors with no sleeve.In addition, Marantz's unique noise-killer element is inserted between the windings of each rectifier circuit to absorb high-frequency noise during rectification.Equipped with a balanced input for CD.For the balanced input, impedance conversion is performed with a voltage follower using a Bar Brown high-speed OP amplifier, and then accurate mixing is performed up to high frequencies using the same OP amplifier. As a result, in-phase components such as external noise are canceled over a wide band, taking advantage of balanced transmission.The interior is based on a solid and highly accurate copper-plated high-density zinc die-cast chassis. On top of this chassis, the layout takes into account sufficient separation of left and right channels, small signal and large signal areas, rational signal flow and efficient power supply.A logic relay system is used to provide optimum layout for switching between input and REC output.The relay uses a highly reliable sealed type for the communication industry.All unbalanced input terminals are gold-plated, especially for the CD input terminals, which use wide pitch machined terminals.There are two sets of speaker terminals made by WBT (Germany). These terminals can be used with Y-lugs or banana plugs. They can also be used with thick cables for reliable mounting. In addition, they are designed so that there is no difference in sound quality. This makes it possible to use two sets of speakers or connect by wire.Pre-in pre-out and power-in terminals allow the use of a pre-amplifier and a power amplifier independently. In integrated use, the pre-amplifier and power amplifier are designed to be connected as quickly as possible by means of a changeover switch.Also, in consideration of the use of active subwoofer, the pre-out is designed to be output even when integrated.System remote control is included.

sections.title: MARANTZ PM-14SA
sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier based on the PM-14 for Super Audio (next-generation digital audio).The basic configuration is based on the PM-14. It uses a strong and high precision copper plated and high density zinc die-cast chassis with a phono equalizer amplifier, balance buffer amplifier, preamp, tone control amplifier, power amplifier and power supply mounted on top of it. The layout remains unchanged.In addition to the current feedback type used in the power amplifier of the PM-14SA, we have also adopted a newly designed current feedback type in the preamplifier section. By realizing a preamplifier with high drive capability with low noise and high slew rate, we aim to ensure high speed and dynamic range of unit amplifiers for next-generation digital audio.As for the circuit configuration, a voltage amplification module with adjustable HDAM with DC offset adjustment is adopted at the first stage. Impedance conversion is performed by the FET buffer, and current feedback is injected into it. This realizes high S/N ratio and low output impedance.The power amplifier section uses a current feedback type and reduces the feedback impedance to reduce the phase compensation and realize a high-speed amplifier. This method ensures stability against load fluctuations while eliminating the choke coil in the output section, which affects sound quality, and is also advantageous in terms of S/N.The circuit configuration is connected from the first stage where the adjustable HDAM amplifies the voltage, to the power amplifier of the 3-stage Darlington which obtains the DC amplification factor through the I/V conversion part using the current mirror circuit after the impedance conversion. The output stage is a single push-pull type with a multi-emitter bipolar transistor of Pc = 200W. In this circuit, 100% DC feedback is applied to the first stage and the DC offset adjustment of the adjustable HDAM is carried out to eliminate the DC servo by the active element which causes a problem in S/N, etc. by adjusting the DC offset of the adjustable HDAM.The power transistor is set on a large heat sink via a copper cover for vibration isolation / shielding.The power supply uses a 450 VA super-ring core toroidal transformer with high efficiency and low magnetic flux leakage. In addition, it is equipped with two large stress-free low-double foil filter capacitors with no sleeve.A unique noise killer element is inserted between the windings of each rectifier circuit to absorb high-frequency noise during rectification.Equipped with an NF-type phono equalizer amplifier for MC/MM cartridges.The first stage uses the latest adjustable HDAM (high-speed voltage amplifier module) with low-noise FET, and the output uses a high-gain, high-slew rate audio OP amplifier.In the balanced buffer amplifier, the impedance is converted by the voltage follower of the OP amplifier, and then mixed by the same OP amplifier to cancel in-phase components such as external noise over a wide band, taking advantage of balanced transmission.A logic relay system is used for switching between input and recording output.The relay uses a highly reliable sealed type for the communication industry.All unbalanced input terminals are gold-plated. Especially for CD input terminals, wide-pitch machined terminals are used for high-grade cables.The speaker terminal is made by WBT of Germany, and it is compatible with banana plug, Y lug and thick cable.Equipped with an input / output terminal and a selector switch for independent use of a preamplifier and power amplifier.In consideration of the use of active woofer, the pre-out terminal is designed to be in the output state even when integrated.Wireless remote control is included.

In addition, the power supply line is made as short as possible, and the ground potential is completely reviewed to eliminate potential fluctuations.The Schottky barrier diode, which was also used in the separate amplifier, is fully adopted in each rectifier circuit to achieve high efficiency and low noise.The preamplifier uses the current feedback circuit that is also used in the PM-14SA. It also uses the high-precision low-noise metal-coated resistor and polypropylene film capacitor used in the separate amplifier to achieve low noise and high slew rate.The first stage employs an adjustable HDAM voltage amplification module that can adjust the DC offset. The FET buffer is used for impedance conversion and power feedback is injected into it. The second stage uses a SEPP + diamond output circuit with bipolar transistors to provide a high-speed, high-current amplification factor and a power amp-like configuration to ensure sufficient drive capability.A conventional current feedback circuit is also used for the power amplifier, and the film capacitor and resistor used in the separate amplifier are used. By reducing the feedback impedance, phase compensation can be made lighter and a high-speed amplifier is realized. This circuit is stable against load fluctuations and can remove the choke coil in the output section, which is harmful to sound quality. This circuit is also advantageous in terms of S/N.The circuit is connected from the first stage, where the voltage is amplified by a high-speed adjustable HDAM, to the power amplifier of a 3-stage Darlington, where the DC amplification factor is obtained through an I/V converter using a current mirror circuit after impedance conversion. The output stage is a single-push-pull configuration with a Pc = 200W multi-emitter bipolar transistor.By applying 100% DC feedback to the first stage and adjusting the offset of the adjustable HDAM, it is possible to eliminate DC servo due to active element which is a problem in S/N, etc.The power transistor is set on the heat sink via a copper cover with high vibration isolation / shielding effect.The CD input terminal uses a wide pitch shaved terminal.The speaker terminal is made by WBT of Germany.Equipped with an input / output terminal and a selector switch for independent use of the preamplifier and power amplifier.In consideration of the use of active woofer, the pre-out is designed to be output even when integrated.In addition, by setting the gain of the power amplifier section to the same value as that of SM-17SA ver. 2, the possibility of bi-amplifier connection is obtained.Uses a copper plated high density zinc die-cast chassis.Equipped with a phono equalizer amplifier.Uses solid aluminum insulator.Conductor cross-sectional area 2 mm2The OFC power cable is included.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier is the successor to the long-selling model PM-80.We have introduced technologies used in high-end models such as full-scale 3-amplifier configuration, new MOS FET, and 4-channel active volume.In order to suppress distortion and maintain high stability against the input of a high-level source such as CD, a three amplifier configuration is adopted in which each amplifier block of pre, tone and power is independent.The first stage of the equalizer, pre-amplifier and power amplifier has the same circuit configuration as the HDAM.A large MOS FET is used in parallel push-pull at the final stage of the power block to ensure high current drive capability.The phono equalizer, which deals with very small levels, has the same circuitry as the HDAM.Four active volumes are used to significantly improve the S/N in actual use.The pre-section, which has the same circuit structure as the HDAM, is integrated with the volume unit, and is copper shielded to obtain high S/N.The power supply section uses a large power transformer and a 15,000 ? Fx2 special specification low-power foil electrolytic capacitor.In addition, a noise killer element that absorbs high-frequency noise is used for the output power supply and the voltage amplifier power supply.Die-cast side panels hold the chassis from both sides to increase rigidity.There are 2 color variations of gold and black.

sections.title: MARANTZ PM-84
sections.overview: This is a pre-main amplifier equipped with Marantz digital support technology and designed for high sound quality with Quarter A and AVSS.A Quarter A circuit has been developed and installed on the PM-84 in order to achieve both high output, which does not clip even at high level, and quality at low output, which reproduces low level.This Quarter A operates in pure A class with excellent linearity for low level up to 1/4 (quarter) of maximum output, and moves to AB class at higher level to realize high power.Each operation achieves a smooth shift by controlling the bias current with a high-speed switch circuit.Equipped with an AVSS (Auto Voltage Shift Supply) that shifts the output supply voltage according to the power. The optimum output supply voltage allows the power element to operate in a region with minimal distortion and noise, etc., realizing high quality at all power levels from small output to large output.Moreover, improves stability by suppressing unnecessary temperature rise at low power.Designed for low impedance, it maintains power even when the speaker impedance momentarily fluctuates to an extremely low value.Equipped with a direct switch, power is directly connected to enable higher SN ratio and high-speed signal transmission.Analog disk playback is handled by configuring a phono amplifier with a dedicated phono IC and dual FET.In addition, it has a 2-position MC input.All basic parts, including the power supply, are strictly checked through hearing tests, and more than 100 parts are replaced.The power supply section is equipped with a high regulation large transformer of the separate amplifier class and a newly developed custom electrolytic capacitor. In addition to the copper chassis, 2/3 of the screws used are copper screws. This structure emphasizes sound quality.The side wood was sold separately.

sections.title: MARANTZ PM-84D
sections.overview: Based on the PM-84, this pre-main amplifier was developed in pursuit of higher quality reproduction sound in order to realize 100% of CD capability.The PM-84D has a MOS FET at the output stage.The MOS FET has excellent switching characteristics, distortion characteristics, and thermal characteristics, making it ideal for use as a power amplifier. The MOS FET uses a parallel push-pull configuration and eight MOS FETs for both channels.MOS FET parallel push-pull configuration output stage is controlled by Quarter A and AVSS.Quarter A operates at 1/4 (quarter) of the maximum output, and operates at pure A class up to 25Wx2. Beyond that, it automatically moves to AB class to obtain high power, making it possible to reproduce a wide power range with excellent linearity.In addition, the AVSS drives the power element in an ideal state by shifting the output supply voltage in conjunction with switching between pure class A and class AB.Equipped with CD/Phono direct switch.The CD Direct is directly connected to the flat amplifier just by passing through the volume, and the Phono Direct is played through the shortest path of the phono amplifier, volume, flat amplifier, and power amplifier.By passing through the minimum necessary stages for both digital and analog, more pure amplification is possible.The Phono input is equipped with a MM/MC (High) / MC (Low) selector switch, and is compatible with various cartridges.The power supply section is equipped with a high-regulation 3-shield large transformer filled with resin to increase heat radiation efficiency and eliminate magnetic flux leakage, and newly developed custom large-capacity capacitors, mainly 76,000 ? F electrolytic capacitors.In order to improve the final sound quality, tuning is repeatedly conducted through thorough hearing tests. Non-magnetic materials are actively used for parts that may be affected by eddy currents such as chassis and screws, and copper-plated chassis and copper-plated screws are used.In addition, more than 100 parts are examined through hearing to improve sound quality.

sections.title: MARANTZ PM-88SE
sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier developed as a special edition of the PM-80.Based on the concept that the power source is the basis of the amplifier, we have adopted a toroidal transformer for the power source. It is ideal as an amplifier transformer due to its excellent regulation (current supply capacity) and low natural vibration.In addition, a custom-made large-capacity electrolytic capacitor is mounted.OFC wires are used for speaker circuits, power cords, and internal wiring materials to ensure smooth current flow.In addition, as a countermeasure against rectification noise, which affects sound quality even by an extremely small amount, a powerful noise-killer element is mounted, which absorbs high-frequency noise generated during rectification and realizes sound quality without turbidity.The power amplifier section uses a power transistor with a Pc (collector loss) of 100W in parallel push-pull, and the circuit configuration is three stage Darlington connection to increase the gain.The PM-88SE uses pure class A amplification with 20W/ch (8  ) output. With class AB amplification, in which the plus and minus sides of the signal are shared by separate transistors, switching distortion occurs at the moment when the transistor is turned on or off when the music signal changes from the plus side to the minus side. However, with class A amplification, since all the waves of the signal are processed by the same transistor, switching distortion does not occur as with class AB amplification, and switching distortion is suppressed.When large power is required, it is also possible to switch to class AB amplification.The shield plate of the OFC that fixes the power transistor reduces unnecessary radiation generated by the transistor.The Phono Equalizer is a low-noise amplifier that combines a low-noise FET with an audio IC. Careful attention is paid to the fidelity of the low-level analog disk signal.It also reduces the effect of analog disk warpage by attenuating the 30 Hz ultra-low band.In addition, careful attention is paid to the selection of parts. For example, an electrolytic capacitor made of silk separator is used for the coupling capacitor, and a paper polyester substrate with excellent vibration control is used for the printed circuit board.The case uses side die-cast to protect each circuit from internal and external vibration. Together with other anti-vibration parts, the effect of vibration is eliminated.The chassis is entirely copper plated to prevent high frequency waves from penetrating other circuits and components.In addition, the adoption of a 3 mm thick anti-vibration top cover suppresses vibration of the amplifier itself and reduces vibration from the outside.Solid aluminum knob is used for both volume and selector.It greatly reduces the effect of the volume shaft vibration, especially the volume knob does not simply attach a solid knob, but a large washer secures the volume itself.Input is equipped with Phono 1 system (MM/MC switching), line 4 system and tape input / output Route 3.There is also one processor input / output terminal.The speaker terminal is equipped with two banana plug terminals.

sections.title: MARANTZ PM-90
sections.overview: This is a pre-main amplifier with a thorough brush-up of basic performances by tackling "reproduction of stereo images" and "improvement of sound S/N" from the front.It was developed in pursuit of sound quality in actual use condition rather than catalog specification.Uses a 4-row active volume system to prevent S/N degradation during actual use.As the input signal becomes smaller when the volume is reduced, residual noise in the pre-section is suppressed to obtain a high S/N ratio.In the power amplifier section, we have constructed a high-speed, low-impedance voltage amplifier using cascode technology.The power stage consists of a parallel push-pull bipolar transistor, and the driver stage uses a MOS FET to prevent electrical interference.The power supply unit is composed of two power transformers, each of + and -, for a total of 500 va.In addition, the current directions of the two transformers are set to be opposite to each other so as to cancel each other's leakage flux.The chassis is made of zinc die-cast and is secured with 3 mm thick top panel and die-cast side panel to reduce vibration.Equipped with an AC polarity indicator that allows you to check the polarity of the power cord at a glance.

sections.title: MARANTZ PM-94
sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier with Marantz's separate amplifier technology.The output stage is a triple push-pull configuration using MOS FET.MOS FET has characteristics such as "excellent high-frequency characteristics, high withstand voltage and high power can be applied at the same time", "because it operates only with majority carriers in principle, high input impedance higher than that of J-FET is realized", and "because there is little accumulation effect during switching, turn-off time is extremely shortened and high-speed switching is possible". Together with Marantz's original Quarter A, MOS FET realizes ideal operation.Using a unique Quarter A circuit, it performs full class A operation up to 1/4 of the maximum output and automatically shifts to class AB operation up to the maximum output. This autoshift is controlled by an electronic control. It detects the output voltage of the main amplifier and controls the bias current with a high-speed switching circuit.The detection speed of the PM-94 circuit is higher than that of the conventional Quarter A circuit, enabling smoother control.In order to fully demonstrate the performance of the MC cartridge, two high performance MC transformers are mounted on the MC input independently on the left and right sides.This transformer has a 2-coil configuration and uses double shielding in the core direction and winding direction. It has a quality close to that of the high-sound MC transformer "MC1000".The step-up ratio is switchable between High and Low.The power supply section is equipped with a large transformer and a 90,000 ? F large electrolytic capacitor.In particular, toroidal transformers are shielded by three layers of silicon steel plates to prevent flux.Copper-plated steel sheet material "Copper-Tight" is used throughout the chassis, and the uniform copper-plated finish of Copper-Tight is more effective than conventional copper plating.Thorough tuning has been applied, such as using parts that have been examined through hearing.We have adopted a pair electrolytic capacitor with equivalent characteristics and sound quality, and switches with improved sound quality by copper-plating. In addition, 70-micron thick circuit boards and oxygen-free copper wires are used.In addition, in order to eliminate the change in sound quality caused by soldering, the condenser is fixed with screws and all screws are copper plated screws.Equipped with a CD direct position. In this position, the input selector is directly connected to the flat amplifier by jumping to a stage such as an input selector or a tape monitor. Moreover, since the flat amplifier is an FET input, the change in input impedance is almost negligible even when the resistance of the master volume itself changes.Equipped with HiFiVCR monitor position, you can enjoy music playback by HiFiVCR with the same feeling as a tape monitor.

sections.title: MARANTZ PM-94LIMITED
sections.overview: Based on PM-94, this is a limited model focusing on the sound quality with construction and materials.Power element MOS FET is mounted on the output stage.The combination of the output stage of the MOS FET triple push-pull configuration and the unique circuit technology "Quarter A" auto-shifts the pure A and AB class by electronic control, and drives the speaker powerfully from low level to high level.Equipped with CD/Phono Direct Position for pure and high-quality music playback, and equipped with MC Transformer to guarantee the sound quality of advanced MC cartridge.In addition, a dedicated position for HiFi VCR is available for AV sources.We have reviewed the PM-94 from the material side and are pursuing higher sound quality.We continue to use a new material called "Coppertight" for copper-plated copper plates, and attach a non-magnetic material to the resonance part to improve resonance dispersion and strength by joining dissimilar metals.In addition, the conventional steel plate top plate has been replaced with non-magnetic aluminum drawing material to eliminate mutual interference caused by eddy current.In order to reduce vibration and resonance from the outside, the space inside the large insulator is filled with Portland cement, and other thorough anti-vibration measures are implemented.The power supply unit is based on Marantz's traditional power-oriented concept, and consists mainly of a large toroidal transformer and a specially designed large electrolytic capacitor for HiFi audio.It is finished with the highest priority on sound quality even in details such as parts selection by hearing and repeated tuning.

sections.title: MARANTZ PM-95
sections.overview: Digital integrated amplifier with D/A converter.The D/A converter uses the TDA1541A-S1 LSI, which is carefully selected from the "A Version" of the Philips / Marantz group and has a crown mark that certifies the highest quality. It realizes sound quality with excellent reproducibility especially at low levels.The power amplifier section has a simple structure in which the input signal is directly sent from the volume. The first stage is differential amplification with cascode connection, and sufficient gain is secured by the combination of FET and bipolar transistor.The output stage has a triple push-pull configuration and uses a Power-MOS FET, which is an audio power amplifier. In addition, two types of operation, pure class A operation and class AB operation class AB operation.The power supply is equipped with a large toroidal transformer and a large-capacity LowESR type condenser, and a oxygen-free copper 1.53 mm in diameter is used for the wiring material to powerfully drive the speakers.In addition, in order to prevent digital noise from entering the analog circuit, independent power supply parts are adopted, and the analog circuit is equipped with high-speed power supply utilizing high-integration IC with low-noise broadband.In addition, a non-magnetic copper plate is also used for the mounting bracket of the condenser, giving consideration to sound quality.By adopting a copper-plated diecast chassis and diecast side panels, we have achieved a highly rigid structure that is less susceptible to mechanical distortion. In addition, the heat sink is an independent structure on the left and right, made of high-strength aluminum, and provides natural air cooling with high efficiency and no resonance.In addition, the volume knob has been machined out of aluminum, and the printed circuit board has a polyester base with a copper foil pattern of 70 ? m thick. In this way, we are thoroughly pursuing vibration-free and resonance-free.In addition, a shield that completely cuts off the digital and analog sections, high-performance relays (25 pieces) are used for function switching, and pattern wiring is connected at the shortest distance to improve separation.The D/A converter output can be fed directly to the master volume by means of a digital direct switch.Separately sold remote controller RC-95PM with command memory (learning function) is available, and remote control operation of PM-95 and other AV devices is possible from the listening position.

sections.title: MARANTZ PM4001
sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier has been developed by incorporating as much as possible the technology of the advanced equipment.The pre-amplifier, power amplifier and tone control amplifier are separated as in the case of the high-grade model.In particular, the power amplifier achieves high class performance by making it a completely discrete type, and the tone control amplifier section uses the well-established active filter type and achieves excellent flat characteristics at the center level.In addition, an input buffer circuit using the same method as the PM-15S1 is incorporated to improve S/N and channel separation.Sound quality is improved by tuning the ground processing.The ground point of the headphone output is divided into two parts, one under the circuit and the other near the headphone jack on the front panel. The ground of the volume board is made into L/R independent wiring to improve crosstalk.In addition, the communication and control wiring from the microcomputer and the power wiring are optimized so that they do not adversely affect the music signal.A phono equalizer is built in for MM cartridges.Equipped with a tone defeat switch, you can bypass the tone circuit with one touch operation.The use of aluminum for the front panel, volume and input selector gives it a luxurious feel, and also contributes to stable reproduction by improving rigidity.Equipped with a loudness function.Equipped with a full REC selector, you can record on the back of a CD or tuner tape decks.Marantz Equipped with remote control terminal.There are 2 color variations of gold and black.Wireless remote control is included.With this remote control, you can turn the power on / off, adjust the volume, switch the source, and perform basic operations such as CD Player CD5001, Marantz CD/MD deck, tuner, etc.

sections.title: MARANTZ PM8100SA
sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier inherits the design philosophy of the PM-14SA and PM-17SA and is compatible with next-generation audio.The DVD input supports a 6-channel input, and you can add a power amplifier to play SACD, DVD Audio, and other multi-channel sources.A pre-power independent configuration is adopted to achieve high sound quality.A newly developed current feedback type is used for all six channels in the preamplifier section to achieve low-noise, high-slew rate, high speed and dynamic range for next-generation audio.The volume uses a motor-driven 6-series volume of die cast frame, which has less channel-to-channel deviation than conventional volumes and higher performance than electronic volumes.The power amplifier section uses a current feedback type. By lowering the feedback impedance, the phase compensation is light and a high-speed amplifier is realized.Power devices use L, A, P, and T transistors with excellent high-frequency characteristics, and separate left and right heat sinks to reduce vibration and thermal crosstalk.The power supply section uses a super-ring-core toroidal transformer and a high-speed, low-loss, low-noise Schottky barrier rectifier.The speaker terminal uses the latest model of the standard SA series pre-main amplifier made by WBT in Germany, and supports banana plug and Y lug.The chassis is a double-layered chassis with an additional 1.6 mm thick steel bottom plate to reduce the impact of external vibration on sound quality and improve chassis strength.Equipped with a CD & DVD direct input that is directly connected to the preamplifier section by a dedicated relay.Equipped with a full Rec selector with Rec buffer.The input / output terminals are gold-plated.An inlet type AC cable is used.

sections.overview: Based on the PM8100SA, Marantz's original Absolute SA Technology circuit speedup technology has been introduced to improve the completion of this pre-main amplifier.It has multi-channel input / output terminals, and can be developed to multi-channel playback by adding a power amplifier such as SM6100SA ver. 2.Audio only capacitors are used in 17 decoupling capacitors in the pre and power sections, and newly developed high-quality film capacitors are used everywhere. sections.title: MARANTZ PS9200
sections.overview: This is a flagship model of AV amplifier developed based on original technology such as "Absolute SA Technology" aiming to correspond to high density source such as SACD.The PS9200 is available in early and late versions : the early version supports the THX Ultra standard, the later version supports the THX Ultra2 standard, and only the later version adds playback modes such as THX Ultra2 Cinema and THX Music.In addition, for the PS9200 sold by March 31, 2002, a version upgrade service was provided by rewriting the DSP and control software for a limited time.The PS9200 supports multi-channel formats such as THX Surround EX 7.1 ch, DTS-ES Discrete6.1/Matrix6.1 and MPEG2 AAC, and realizes high performance by installing two high-precision 24-bit DSPs.The dolby Pro LogicII, DTS Neo : 6 : 6, SRS Circle Surround 5.1, and other decoders that allow you to enjoy multi-channel surround of all 2 channel sources. You can also set the CINEMA/MUSIC mode for the appropriate decoding for movies / music.The power amplifier section is equipped with a current feedback type high power discrete amplifier based on Marantz's original high sound quality technology "Absolute SA Technology". It is also compliant with Lucasfilm's THX Ultra2 and achieves the same performance for all seven channels.The preamplifier section reduces noise by a low-impedance drive with a buffer amplifier and a low-distortion polysilicon resistor volume.The D/A converter uses a 192 kHz / 24-bit DA converter (CS4396) made by Cirrus Logic for all channels.For 2-channel playback, four DACs are used in double differential mode to achieve excellent music playback.The power supply is equipped with a large toroidal transformer and a well-designed block Chemicon.A block independent bus system is adopted in which the control bus for the microcomputer is separated for each block. In this system, a dedicated bus is provided for each block with different operation to prevent interference of excessive digital signals with other blocks. In addition, bus switches are provided for each function of the bus for the analog section, so that when it is not related to operation, it is disconnected from the bus line.A video off mode that stops the operation of the video output processing circuit when music is played back, and a copper-plated chassis are installed to reduce noise.Surround settings and basic settings can be freely set on the console by multi-dial.On-screen menu functions up to component output are provided.It is equipped with an HDCD decoder that can play HDCD software by digitally connecting to a CD player or DVD player.It is equipped with a multi-room speaker-out function that enables you to use a surround back or a built-in surround amplifier for multi-room use.It has a 7.1 channel direct input jack, and can be used as an AUX2 (stereo) input when the 7.1 channel input is not used.Equipped with RS232C terminal.It is equipped with video input / output terminals such as D4 terminal and 10-system Euterpe oleracea cable digital input terminals.Equipped with an on-screen display function for multi-room output.Equipped with a Euterpe oleracea navable DC trigger terminal that can operate in conjunction with devices such as projectors.Equipped with an auto-adjust function that automatically adjusts to an appropriate value when there is an error in the speaker settings.Equipped with a TV auto-on function that turns the power of the main unit on / off automatically depending on the presence or absence of a video signal.It comes with a bi-directional GUI learning remote controller equipped with an LCD touch panel that allows you to graphically check the settings and operation status of the main body at hand.

sections.title: MARANTZ ST-5
sections.overview: FM/AM tuner that uses a quartz-lock digital synthesizer system.The front end is equipped with a quartz-locked digital synthesizer system. In this system, the local frequency is accurately locked at 100 kHz for FM and 9 kHz for AM based on a reference signal from a crystal oscillator. This system improves stability against environmental changes such as temperature and humidity, and minimizes distortion due to misalignment of tuning. In addition, with the synthesizer system, in which the frequency is selected by changing the voltage applied to the varicap, everything is controlled electronically, so there is no mechanical operation part and no misalignment due to external shocks such as vibration.The St-5 has a built-in preset mechanism that allows you to preset a total of 14 stations (7 FM stations and 7 AM stations). With its unique mechanism, stored stations do not disappear even after the power is turned off.It uses a convenient auto-tuning system that allows you to select stations accurately without having to remember the frequency of each station. Manual operation is also possible by switching the tuning switch to the normal switch.The frequency display is directly displayed on the digital display by counting down the quartz-locked local frequency. As a result, the indication error is 0. At the best tuning point, there is no distortion or degradation of separation.The front end with improved tuning performance using a quartz-lock synthesizer system uses a low-noise dual-gate MOS-FET to achieve high frequency amplification characteristics with excellent distortion factor and S/N ratio.The IF stage, which had been difficult to achieve both reception and sound quality, is divided into a main IF stage and a sub IF stage to improve both reception and sound quality.In addition, a PLL pilot canceler circuit is used in the MPX stage to improve separation characteristics over a wide range.The digitally displayed frequency is designed so that there is no deviation in tuning, but it is equipped with a signal intensity meter by LED so that the signal strength can be read directly.In addition, this meter can be used for multi-path observation by switching the switch. It can easily check the direction without Radio noises, and can be used for antenna setting to draw out the performances.There was a mahogany cabinet as an option sold separately.

sections.title: MARANTZ AX1000
sections.overview: An audio computer capable of measuring and correcting the acoustic characteristics of a listening room with high digital accuracy without using any external equipment such as an equalizer.All of the audio signal processing is processed digitally, and the D/A converter is equipped with bit storage type SAA7350 in order to minimize degradation of sound quality caused by conversion error between digital and analog.It is also equipped with a 1-bit A/D converter to support analog sources.Uses a simple operation that does not require any specialized procedures required for correction.It is a remote control interactive system, and all operations can be performed simply by selecting the menu displayed on the LCD.It is equipped with 4 functions that add various signal processing after correcting the sound characteristics in the room.A total of 13 types of features can be selected with 4 functions.Two types of frequency response control are provided : a parametric equalizer and room acoustic compensation.The 3-band parametric equalizer allows you to adjust the gain (magnitude of correction) and Q factor (sharpness of correction) at the selected center frequency.In addition, room acoustic compensation is used to compensate for the transmission frequency characteristics of the room. First, the acoustic characteristics of the room are measured and calculated according to the target frequency characteristic curve, so that only the frequency range of the characteristic can be corrected, or an arbitrary characteristic curve can be set.Five types of reverberation control are installed : reverb, concert hall, digital movie surround, stereo control, and headphone sound localization correction.The reverb allows you to control the reverberation characteristics and the concert hall allows you to simulate the reverberation characteristics of eight world-famous concert halls.In digital movie surround, you can improve the surround effect by adding rear and center to the front 2 ch. In stereo control, you can adjust the left and right spread in 11 levels from mono to spatial stereo.The headphone sound image localization correction is a function to correct the localization in the head when using headphones, and releases the localization which comes to the center of the head to the outside of the head.It is equipped with two types of signal characteristic control : dynamic range compression / expansion and scratch noise elimination.Dynamic Range Compression / Expansion controls the dynamic range, and Scratch Noise Elimination eliminates noise caused by scratches on analog disks.Four types of measuring functions are installed : a sinusoidal gray fabric, a white noise gray fabric, a pink noise gray fabric and a real time analyzer.The sine wave generator outputs sine waves with frequencies set in 1 Hz steps within 20 Hz to 20 kHz in the range of -80dB to 0 dB.The White Noise and pink noise generators output their respective noise levels in the range of -80dB to 0 dB.The real-time analyzer operates as a 27-band, 40-Hz-16-kHz real-time analyzer.

sections.title: MARANTZ BTL-1
sections.overview: Dedicated BTL adapter for Marantz amplifier for BTL (Balanced Transformer Less) connection.BTL connection is a circuit technology developed to achieve both low distortion and high power, and is also called bridge connection.Basically, two amplifiers (Lch and Rch for stereo amplifiers) are driven in opposite phase to each other, and a speaker is connected between each output.The two amplifiers driven in opposite phases are powered up by push-pull operation (theoretically four times as high as single output). sections.title: MARANTZ RV-55
sections.overview: Digital sound field controller that realizes digital delay by introducing digital technology cultivated in CD development.This is the first time that a digital delay has been used exclusively for audio. The technology accumulated through the development of CDs has been fully utilized. The A/D and D/A converters are equipped with devices equivalent to CD players.In addition, a 5-band graphic equalizer and a sub-channel power amplifier are incorporated.In digital delay, a delay signal and a reverberation signal are extracted and blended into a direct sound to restore a sense of presence. In the RV-55, an analog signal is digitized to extract a delay signal. The A/D and D/A converters use the same 16-bit A/D and D/A converters as CD player devices, providing a high signal-to-noise ratio and a wide dynamic range.The digitized signal is stored in the ring buffer sequentially and is read out with a specified time difference. The memory capacity which determines the accuracy is 64 kbit.A microcomputer is used to calculate the delay time, and any delay time (0 ~ 99 ms) can be freely set. A one chip microcomputer (8-bit) is also used to control signals such as RAM.The reverb circuit incorporates a dedicated feedback circuit that returns the delayed signal to the input, adds it back to the input, and then returns it to the input of the reverse channel to reproduce the second and third order reflections and the continuously generated reverb components.In addition, the reverb circuit can shift the delay time setting between channels within a range of   15 ms. It can also be used to correct acoustic characteristics when the sound condition of the listening room differs greatly from left to right.The delay time can be preset, and can be set in increments of 1 ms with the up/down switch.The set optimum value can be stored up to 3 points and can be recalled with one touch by the switch.A matrix circuit is installed in the input section to control the difference signal between the left and right channels. It is possible to add a surround effect without damaging the sound image located at the center.Equipped with video input / output terminal.It has a built-in power amplifier for the sub speaker.Equipped with a 5-band graphic equalizer.It is equipped with a master volume that can control the volume of the main system and subsystem simultaneously.A sub-dedicated volume is also installed to adjust the volume balance of the subsystem.Tape dubbing circuit is mounted.

sections.title: MARANTZ RV450PRO
sections.overview: Surround processor with Dolby Pro Logic Decoder.The Dolby Pro-Logic Surround System is a home-use surround system that reproduces the same effect as a movie theater by installing almost the same circuitry as the professional surround decoder developed by the Dolby Research Institute for movie theaters in order to clarify sound localization and realistic sensation.In the Dolby surround sound recording, the front L/R component and the surround component that surrounds the person are recorded in a composite state, and the surround effect is realized by separating and playing back this component.The RV450PRO is equipped with a directional enhancement circuit that improves the front-rear and left-right channel separation from the conventional 3 dB to more than 25 dB. In addition, the 3-channel L, R, and S (surround) playback is replaced with 4-channel L, R, C (center) and S playback to separate the sound image at the center and localizing it.The surround channel is equipped with a digital delay circuit that outputs a signal 20 msec behind the front channel. This greatly reduces noise compared with the conventional analog method and makes sound localization clearer. The surround channel S/N ratio of 96 dB is achieved by using a noise reduction system in this circuit.Equipped with three modes that can be freely selected according to the type and size of the speaker used for the center channel.The normal mode is most suitable for the case where a small speaker is used for the center channel rather than the left and right speakers. The center speaker outputs a signal of 100 Hz or higher, and the signal of 100 Hz or lower, which has little influence on the direction localization, is distributed to the left and right channels.Wide mode is used when the center channel speaker is equipped with a bookshelf type or higher speaker that can fully reproduce overtones. The output separated by the directional enhancement circuit is sent directly to the center channel.Phantom mode is a mode in which no speaker is used for the center channel. The center channel signal is divided equally into left and right by the directional enhancement circuit.In addition to the Dolby Pro Logic Surround mode, Hall Surround and Matrix Surround modes are also built-in.Hall surround gives the sound as if you are listening in a hall, while matrix surround mode cancels out the signal located in the center of the left and right and emphasizes the indirect sound, so that you can play back more realistically, such as a during sport joint.With a built-in test tone generation circuit, the test tone automatically circulates through each channel of L, R, C and S, and the level can be set according to the listening condition.Equipped with a master level controller that can simultaneously control the volume of four channels : L, R, C, and S.It is also equipped with center volume and surround volume that can adjust center output and surround output.

sections.overview: A semi-automatic record player.Equipped with semi-automatic mechanism, auto cut and Oatley turn are possible.When the play is finished, the arm automatically returns to the arm rest and the turntable stops. To stop the play, pull the reject lever to perform the same action.A belt drive system using AC synchronous motor is adopted for the mechanism part, and a 30 cm aluminum die-cast turntable is adopted for the turntable.The newly developed static balanced tone arm is used for the tone arm.The anti-skating mechanism that cancels the inside force of the arm uses a weight type that has been used only in high-end machines until now. sections.title: MARANTZ MODEL6200
sections.overview: A record player with improved operability thanks to a total automatic design.It is an auto-start type. When the control lever is set to the Play position, the arm moves to the predetermined position with the record size selector and starts playing. When the play is finished, the arm automatically returns to the arm rest and the power switch is turned off. To stop the play midway, press the Reject button.Also, when the control lever is set to Repeat, the disc on the turntable will automatically repeat playing. This repeat mechanism is also effective when playing from the middle. The needle tip down position can be adjusted with the needle tip down point adjustment screw.If manual operation is desired, set the operation lever to the Manual position.The mechanism uses a belt drive system and is equipped with a high torque AC servo motor with a built-in frequency generator.This motor is a purely electronic control type that detects frequency deviation from time to time.A static balance S-shaped tone arm is used for the tone arm part.This arm has a unique design for internal wiring processing that reduces mutual interference and improves high-frequency separation. This improves sound localization and spread during stereo or 4-channel playback.In addition, the counter weight and dial lock type anti-skating mechanism is designed with an emphasis on operability. In order to help determine the appropriate overhang when replacing the cartridge, an arrow and cross mark are attached to the attached 45 rotation adapter as a guide.Arm is supported by aluminum die-cast Planer.The cartridge uses M95ED manufactured by Schur.It uses a turntable sheet with an emphasis on sound quality, and absorbs vibration energy during tracing by carefully examining the hardness and thickness of the material.

sections.title: MARANTZ MODEL6300
sections.overview: A record player with a direct drive system.The mechanism uses a direct drive system, and an 8-pole 24-slot high-torque DC brushless motor.With a speed ratio of less than 0.4% per hour for 30 minutes, this motor maintains smooth rotation even during long-term use. This is because the pure electronic pocket warmer monitors and automatically controls the rotation, so it is not affected by external noise or power voltage fluctuations, and the influence of load fluctuations is minimized.The tone arm uses a static balance S-shaped tone arm developed by Marantz Laboratory for the Model6300.A gimbal bearing is used as the fulcrum of the arm for a high compliance structure that minimizes friction resistance between the horizontal and vertical rotating parts. In addition, in order to lower the resonance point, damper rubber is inserted into the contact point between the tone arm part and the counterweight part, and the thickness of the lateral balancer shaft that cancels the force from the side is made thicker, so that the sound quality is emphasized even in fine parts.In addition, low-capacitor cables (40 pf per meter or less) suitable for CD-4 4-channel playback are used.The cartridge is equipped with M95ED manufactured by Schur.Electronic auto lift and auto shut-off are adopted.In this system, light emitting diodes and phototransistors detect the end of the performance and perform auto lift and auto shut-off.In addition, an electro-hydraulic system is used for queue control.The cabinet is designed to affect sound quality as well as the design.Double insulators are used for the legs. This is a special structure consisting of a hard rubber that contacts the player body and a cushion rubber that supports it. It absorbs acoustic feedback and vibrations from the floor, which adversely affect sound quality, and provides excellent howling margin.In addition, the body can be horizontally adjusted by turning the outer ring.

sections.title: MARANTZ TT1000
sections.overview: A direct drive player with a 3-layer structure cabinet.Returning to the foundations of oscillation theory, where materials of different masses can be used in the sandwich structure to convert vibrational energy into thermal energy, we focused on high-density glass and pure aluminum to drive vibration transmission out of the cabinet. It has a three layer structure consisting of 8 mm thick aluminum plates and special glass (15 mm thick and 7.5 kg weight), which is designed to increase the accuracy of the plane, on top and bottom, so that no unnecessary howling or reverberation is generated.For the turntable seat, we do not use materials with high internal loss such as rubber to absorb vibration, but we use 5 mm thick hard glass with excess hardness and weight for non-core copper based on the concept of structure that does not absorb vibration itself.In order to ensure that uniform weights are always applied to discs with sleds, and to achieve the full performance of all types of cartridges, we have adopted a mass variable dynamic balance tone arm that can change the effective mass of the arm according to compliance.For the aluminum material of the straight type with reduced effective mass, super aluminum alloy with small mass and high strength is used, and the connector part with the head shell is a semi-integrated type with insert-type surface contact that does not generate resonance due to rattling.The Phono Motor drives a heavy duty turntable weighing 3.4 kg and is equipped with a newly developed high-torque DD motor specially ordered by Marantz. With a strong magnetic circuit, the starting torque can reach 1.6 kg.It reaches normal rotation in 1/2 rotation after starting. Furthermore, the rotation system realizes high precision and accurate rotation by the moment of inertia of this heavy duty turntable for dynamic load fluctuation, and by the whole circumference detection method and quartz lock mechanism for static load fluctuation such as drift.In order to ensure a trace free from unwanted vibration, the arm base is made of aluminum muck material carved out of a large block. By rotating this part, the tone arm of effective length from 190 mm to 230 mm can be mounted universally.Moreover, it is possible to upgrade to a double arm by using the sub-arm space provided in the left back.Air-suspension type insulator with sufficient absorber capacity is adopted.The height of this insulator can be adjusted freely, and the horizontal reference of the turntable can be set accurately.Independent power supply configuration that achieves low distortion regeneration without receiving any harmful hum caused by power supply induction.Through a perfect vibration-free design The power SW and speed switching SW use a touch sensor system that only touches the finger.Equipped with an electromagnetic brake that powerfully controls the turntable with a stop button.LED indicator lamp for low speed rotation.

sections.overview: As a basic type of cassette deck, this model was developed to record and reproduce digital sound such as CD in the best condition.One is based on the concept of thoroughly pursuing basic performance, and the other is designed with emphasis on basic performance.The mechanism system uses a flywheel made of sintered alloy with a large inertial mass, enabling stable tape travel.We have also succeeded in improving the stability of the tape by balancing the flywheel and selecting the drive belt for tune-up.The head uses a high-hardness permalloy for the recording and reproducing head, and the hyperbolic shape realizes a stable head touch.It is equipped with a Dolby HX PRO that controls the bias current according to the music signal, thereby improving the high-frequency characteristics and dynamic range.In addition, it is equipped with a bias fine tuning mechanism so that different bias characteristics can be controlled for each tape, metal, chrome, and normal. Recording can be performed by drawing out the characteristics of each tape.In addition, Dolby B/C is also installed.Equipped with a large display, it can be switched between two modes : a normal tape counter and a linear counter that displays the elapsed time of recording and playback in minutes and seconds.In addition, all operational states are displayed on the display with characters such as digital characters so that the operational state can be understood at a glance.Equipped with a peak memory function that digitally displays peak levels from 0 dB to + 12 dB in 1 dB steps during recording.It is also equipped with a MAX Peak Memory function that stores the maximum recording level and allows you to maximum level at random with the memory call key.Equipped with a QMS (Quick Music Sensor) that can cue up to 15 songs in front and back.If you press the pause button during a search operation to find the beginning of a song (playback pause), the FOMA terminal waits.It is equipped with functions such as AMS (Automatic Music Scan) which plays the intro of each song (approximately 10 seconds) one after another, repeat playback which repeatedly plays the song being played, blank skip which searches for the unrecorded portion of the tape being played and automatically fast-forwards it, memory rewind which automatically rolls back to the place where the recording started when the REW key is pressed directly during recording, and stop state, autospace, rec mute function, etc.

sections.title: MARANTZ SD-60
sections.overview: A 3-head cassette deck developed with the concept of thorough pursuit of basic performance.In order to realize the ideal tape travel, we are thoroughly pursuing the travel mechanism.It uses a newly developed precision die-cast integrated head base and integrates parts that affect running performance, such as capstan & pinch roller head block and cassette guide pins. The combination with a precision large flywheel with a large inertial mass dramatically improves running performance.In addition, the closed-loop dual-capstan system, which consists of two capstan and pinch rollers, realizes stable tape head touch and greatly reduces modulation noise and level fluctuation.The twin belt drive system reduces the load fluctuation of the motor and eliminates uneven rotation, resulting in stable tape tension and head touch.In addition, we have adopted a unique cassette half stabilizer that reduces the vibration of the cassette half with a surface instead of a point, reducing the slight vibration and modulation distortion of the cassette half.A dedicated device developed for the recording amplifier has been adopted in order to achieve thorough low-noise and to reproduce purer high-quality sound.A constant current drive system capable of supplying the required recording current without being affected by the inductive impedance of the recording head has been realized, and flat frequency characteristics have been obtained by correcting the characteristics of the recording head and tape.In addition, the S/N ratio of the reproduced equalizer amplifier is improved by installing a differential part composed of low-noise FET based on the know-how of phono amplifier circuit developed by Marantz high-end amplifier.The core material of the recording / playback combination head uses high-hardness permalloy with excellent magnetic properties.PCOCC (single-crystal high-purity oxygen-free copper) with significantly reduced signal loss is used for the sections.title: MARANTZ SD-64
sections.overview: A cassette deck equipped with various functions and a noise reduction system to support digital audio.Equipped with Oatley bath function by infrared photo sensor and rotary head.The infrared photo sensor detects the difference in reflectivity between the magnetic part of the tape and the leader part, and the rotary head immediately rotates to perform reverse operation.The rotary head can record and play back both ways with the same head, so there is no difference in sound quality, and azimuth adjustment is possible in both directions.The mechanism is equipped with 2K byte dedicated microcomputer + 3 motors (1 motor for capstan, 1 motor for reel, and 1 motor for head movement) for reliable and stable operation.A large flywheel is used to obtain smooth rotation.Dynamically stable back tension is maintained by the newly developed tension mechanism dynamic stability tension system using new material Rulon.It is equipped with a double dummy head in order to eliminate the dispersion of travel performance in round trip, which is a problem in reverse deck.Both sides of the rotary head are equipped with dummy heads to maintain accurate tape position and achieve stable tape travel.The audio circuit has a DC configuration with only two coupling capacitors from input to output. The head-connected DC configuration improves the phase characteristics.In addition, the audio system, the logic circuit for each display control, and the power circuit are separated from each other to improve sound quality by reducing the influence.The noise reduction system is equipped with Dolby B/C and dbx.Equipped with a sync recording function, you can control the recording start with the player start of the playback device by combining it with a device with a sync recording terminal (such as CD-84).It is equipped with a blank search function that finds the beginning of an unrecorded portion of a recorded tape, checks the playback until about three minutes ahead, returns to the beginning of the unrecorded portion, and performs recording standby (REC/PAUSE).It is equipped with a quick rewind function. If you press the rewind switch after recording, it returns to the position where the recording started and automatically goes into play standby (play / pause).It is equipped with an Auto Rec Mute function that makes a 4-second non-recording part with one touch and automatically records on standby.Equipped with a QMS (Quick Music Sensor) function that allows you to skip 20 songs before and after.It is equipped with an index scan function that plays the head part of each song for 10 seconds.Equipped with a memory function, the position of the tape can be memorized by operating the memory switch, and stop or play at that position.You can repeat one song by pressing the play switch twice.It is equipped with a volume that can control output output and headphone output.It is equipped with a large display including a peak hold level meter and 4-way digital counter.It is equipped with a Marantz bus system and can be remotely controlled when connected to a model equipped with a balance bus system.

sections.overview: This is an improved special edition cassette deck based on SD-66.Many improvements such as toroidal transformer have been made.Various technologies have been put into the mechanism to ensure the ideal tape running.A die-cast head base with integrated parts that control the running and a fly wheel made of high-precision high-weight ceramic. A closed-loop dual capstan system that realizes stable tape head touch. A cassette half stabilizer that effectively eliminates microvibration and modulation distortion of the cassette half realizes stable tape running performance.The head part is equipped with a recording / re-combination head, and the core material uses high hardness permalloy with excellent magnetic characteristics.In addition, the head coil is made of PC-OCC (single-crystal high-purity oxygen-free copper material) to minimize signal loss and provide optimal gap settings for recording and playback.The recording and playback amplifiers are independent from each other to achieve a low noise level.The recording amplifier uses a constant current drive system that can supply the required current without being affected by the inductive impedance of the recording head.The first stage of the regenerative amplifier uses a low-noise FET in a differential configuration, reflecting the know-how of phono amplifier circuits cultivated in high-grade amplifiers and realizing an improved S/N ratio.Equipped with the Dolby HX PRO, which works only during recording and improves high-frequency characteristics, and Dolby B/C with MPX filter.The power supply section employs a toroidal transformer to solve problems such as leakage flux and vibration of the tape running mechanism.It is equipped with a powerful noise killer circuit to deal with rectification noise, which has a large effect on sound quality even by a very small amount, and absorbs high-frequency noise generated during rectification.The body uses a copper-plated chassis to prevent high frequencies from jumping into other elements.In addition, by adopting a 3 mm thick vibration-proof top cover, vibration from the outside is reduced due to its weight, and it becomes a double vibration-proof countermeasure.It uses a large display equipped with functions such as a linear tape counter that can switch the elapsed time from a normal tape counter, a mode character display that displays operation status with characters such as digital characters, and a digital peak level indicator with a 5-second peak level display and a MAX peak level memory function.It is equipped with a QMS (Quick Music Sensor) that starts out the songs you want to listen to, an AMS (Automatic Music Scan) that plays the intro of each song for about 10 seconds one after another, and a blank skip function that detects unrecorded parts during playback and automatically fast-forwards.An auto tape selector that automatically identifies metal, chrome, and normal tape types, a REC calibration that corrects the recording sensitivity of the tape to make the best use of the tape characteristics, a cassette in indicator that notifies the standby of the cassette tape by turning on, and an anti-rec indicator that turns on when the tab for preventing the erasure of the tape is broken.The input / output terminals are equipped with a line input Route 3 and two line outputs (one Fixedx and one Variablex), all of which are gold-plated.

sections.overview: A 3-head reverse deck equipped with Dolby B/C and dbx.The head part uses a combination type 3-head system.In the 3-head system, the optimum gap width is set for both the reproducing head and the recording head to improve the high-frequency characteristics during reproduction and the recording capability during recording. In addition, hard permalloy with excellent magnetic properties is used for the head material to improve MOL.The reverse mechanism uses a rotary system that rotates the head mount.The rotary type has the advantage that the same head can be used for both directions, and the azimuth can be adjusted in both directions, making it easy to achieve uniform characteristics.The reverse position is detected by an infrared photo-sensor system, in which the sensor senses the difference in reflectivity and issues a command for the start of reverse rotation at the moment when the magnetic material disappears and enters the reader tape.An erasing head is installed on both sides of the rotary type combination head to keep the position of the tape accurately.The mechanism section focuses on the accuracy of metal parts, and the total accuracy is improved by thoroughly eliminating distortion during molding.In addition, the flywheel is 1.7 times heavier than the conventional one, reducing sound quality degradation caused by the traveling system.The drive system is a 3-motor double flywheel system.In addition, the SD-74 uses a new back tension mechanism called the Dynamic Stability Tension System, which uses a new material, Rulon, to provide dynamically stable tension.It also has a mechanism that automatically prevents tape from sagging.A 2Kbyte dedicated microcomputer is used for the drive system of the mechanism to improve the certainty, speed and stability of operation.By separating the audio circuit from other circuits, the effect on sound quality is reduced.The audio circuit consists of a DC configuration with only two coupling capacitors. In addition, direct connection from input to output is promoted so that both recording and playback are directly connected to the head.We have also introduced the latest constant-current drive IC for the recording amplifier, and the amplifier driven by a constant current improves the high-frequency saturation level during recording.In addition to the Dolby B and Dolby C type noise reduction systems, it is also compatible with the dbx system.All NR systems can be monitored, so the Dolby B/C is a double circuit.The display section is equipped with a level meter with a peak hold function and a 4-digit digital counter.In addition to the normal tape counter, the digital counter is equipped with functions such as displaying the remaining time of the tape, the elapsed time (wrap type), and displaying the number of songs when the music is selected (when the QMS switch is ON).Features include blank skip, index scan, memory stop / play, repeat (two play button press), blank search, quick rewind, auto-rec mute and timer standby.Synchronized recording is possible by combining with CD-84 etc.Equipped with an output level adjustment volume.It is compatible with the Marantz bus system, and remote control and easy operation are possible by connecting with a machine compatible with the same system.

sections.overview: Click auto reverse cassette deck in pursuit of multifunctionality.It uses a rotary head that solves problems such as differences in sound quality and azimuth adjustment during round-trip operations, and an infrared sensor that detects the tape leader, enabling quick reverse operation.By operating the reverse mode selector, it is possible to record and play back in both directions or one way without turning over the tape.The noise reduction system is equipped with dbx and DolbyC B.Dbx reduces noise by more than 30 dB over the entire audible frequency range and provides high quality sound without distortion even at high recording levels.It also has a dbx disc position that allows you to play a dbx encoded disc, which is dbx-encoded at the time of cutting and decoded at the time of playback for a low-noise, high-dynamic-range sound.In order to realize excellent operability, it is equipped with 2 kbyte electric circuit exclusive microcomputer and 1 kbyte mechanism drive exclusive microcomputer, and in addition, independent motors for capstan, reel, and head movement are installed.Equipped with a tape slack prevention mechanism that automatically takes up the slack when the tape is attached and prevents recording errors.It is equipped with an index scanning function that plays the head part of a song for about 10 seconds, then automatically fast-forwards to the next song and plays again for 10 seconds.Equipped with a Quick Music Sensor (QMS) that can automatically select 31 tracks before and after.Equipped with an auto-rec mute function that creates a 4-second non-recording portion with one touch and automatically enters the recording standby state.One or all songs can be played repeatedly.Equipped with a timer standby switch that can be used in combination with an audio timer to record your absence or play an alarm clock.
