sections.title: MARANTZ SD930
sections.overview: This is a stereo cassette deck with high sound quality using MAAC, Compu-Bias, and dbx technology.It is equipped with MAAC (Marantz Auto Azimuth Control) which is a unique azimuth automatic adjustment function.The MAAC consists of a specially developed 4-slit head and IC, an actuator drive with piezo (piezoelectric ceramic element), and a MAAC phase indicator that displays the amount of azimuth error in real time, enabling accurate error detection and instantaneous response azimuth correction at the world's fastest speed of 3/100 seconds.The 1-chip MAAC-specific IC was originally developed to process the four signals reproduced by the MAAC head, and achieves high reliability by performing phase comparison, pulse conversion, and data processing within the 1-chip IC.It is equipped with a Compu-Bias system that allows the computer to automatically set the optimum bias, level and equalizer settings. The microcomputer controls the bias, level and equalizer (2 points of 7 kHz and 15 kHz) for each channel in 32 steps in approximately 10 seconds. The level and equalizer settings are adjusted three times in a push-up sequence.The optimal recording mode allows you to record 4 data per channel with a total of 8 data for one type of tape. In addition to 24 data of 3 types of normal chrome metal that are stored at the time of shipment, each tape position is equipped with a user memory of 1 memory. Up to 6 memory 48 data can be stored by battery backup.Equipped with 3 types of noise reduction, dbx, Dolby C and B, it can be used depending on the noise reduction of the recording source and the playback tape.Dbx achieves a noise reduction effect of more than 30 dB in the entire audio frequency range, and a wide dynamic range without distortion even in high-level recording.In addition to the conventional Dolby B, it is equipped with Dolby C, which reduces noise by 20 dB (1/10), which is equivalent to 3 times that of Dolby B, which is about 10 dB (1/3).The mechanism uses a 204 pole, 102 pulse all-round integration type pulse servo DD motor. In addition, the BLACK high-precision mechanism, a double chassis structure boasting micron-order accuracy, realizes smooth tape travel.Equipped with a Quick Music Sensor (QMS) that can automatically select 30 songs before and after.The number of songs to be skipped up to the starting point is digitally displayed on the FL counter.Equipped with a repeat function for one song / all songs.Equipped with Auto Slack Take-up function which automatically takes up the slack of the tape.When the tape is wound up in all travel modes, such as recording / playback / fast-forward / rewind, tape travel is automatically stopped so as not to impose unnecessary burden on the tape.Equipped with a timer standby switch that automatically records and plays back using an audio timer.It can be operated from a remote location with the wired remote controller sold separately.

sections.title: MARK_LEVINSON MARK
sections.overview:
2,760,000 (1 set of 2, released in 1989)

Monaural power amplifier developed with improved sound quality based on No20L.The main change from No20L to No20.5L is the improvement of the circuit and circuit elements from the input stage to the voltage amplification stage.Also, taking advantage of the unique modular construction, it is realized by redesigning a single plug-in PC board (card module).The power supply section is equipped with two large-capacity toroidal transformers of 600 VA and has a completely   independent configuration. The electrolytic capacitor is connected in parallel with a high-quality polyethylene type with extremely low noise and excellent impedance characteristics. Moreover, a large-capacity and high-speed regulator circuit is adopted to control all stages of the power amplifier including the output stage.AP-4 circuit board is used for input stage and amplification stage.The voltage amplification stage consists of a 2-stage differential AC amplifier, the first stage consists of a differential circuit with NPN transistor, and the FET is cascode-connected. The second differential amplifier consists of an active broad based current mirror push-pull operation, the voltage amplification stage consists of a 3-stage Darlington configuration, the driver stage consists of triple push-pull, and the output stage consists of an 8-stage para-push-pull configuration.As the power transistor, several candidates selected from all over the world were subjected to characteristic tests again, and the remaining ones were put on for a long time hearing test, and only one bipolar transistor was picked up.The protection circuit is designed to eliminate relays, which can cause sound quality degradation, and to turn off the power in the event of an accident.In addition to the highly reliable CAMAC terminal, the XLR (Canon) terminal is also available for balanced input.In addition, the INVERTING terminal is mounted, and it is possible to bridge two units.Upgrade service included replacement of AP-3 circuit board for No20L to AP-4 circuit board for No20.5L, replacement of power transistor set and replacement of front panel with model No20.5L (AP-3 circuit board, power transistor and front panel were Herman-certified).

sections.title: MARK_LEVINSON MARK
sections.overview: A D/A converter that achieves excellent D/A conversion close to the sound of the master tape itself by polishing the perfection of all circuits of the digital part, analog part and power supply part.The main body contains independent analog circuits on both sides of the tower and digital circuits in the center, ensuring the optimum distance for signal transmission between the two, and complete electrical, mechanical, and thermal separation.The digital section uses a unique digital audio interface receiver (DAIR) that automatically selects three PLL circuits with different matching ranges according to the sampling frequency for the DIR that locks to the input signal, and an 8 x over-sampling type for the subsequent digital filter.The D/A converter features a custom-made 20-bit D/A converter for both the left and right sides. It uses a unique DRDAC (dual reference D/A converter) that separates and processes the digital signal for both the plus and minus sides, and maintains the operation up to the analog outputs. This realizes resolution comparable to that of professional 20-bit AES/EBU.The analog filter is equipped with a Bessel tuning type that uses the latest current amplification op-amp for the feedback loop, and achieves accurate and stable filter characteristics with high-speed operation exceeding that of general voltage op-amp.A Teflon substrate with excellent electrical characteristics is used for the base and analog circuit of the DAC body, giving consideration to the pure transmission of music signals.We have developed a fully separate power supply PLS-330L that incorporates three independent power supply circuits for digital circuits and both channel and analog circuits. Three cables supply DC power to each circuit.We have also adopted carefully selected parts such as toroidal transformers and condensers, and combined them with newly developed stabilizing circuits and circuit layouts to prevent induction noise from AC lines to form a high-quality power supply.The input jacks are equipped with a total of eight inputs : Line 5 balanced input compatible with 20-bit AES/EBU standard for professionals, two optical inputs compatible with Tosrin, and one optical input compatible with ST-standard.As output terminals, two balanced and one unbalanced type for each channel, one coaxial type and one optical type for digital output.

sections.title: MAXONIC D51EX
sections.overview: Top-of-the-line excitation driver designed for professional applications such as theaters and large halls.Each unit is carefully made based on strict quality standards.This driver unit uses an excitation type.In a general speaker unit, it is ideal that the diaphragm moves in the same way as the input signal current. However, because the diaphragm and voice coil are heavy, it does not move immediately when an input is applied, and even when the current stops, it does not stop due to inertia and produces a sound different from the original sound.In order to eliminate this drawback, the excitation type unit creates a particularly strong magnetic field to make the start speed fast, and the voice coil generates a strong back electromotive force to apply complete self-braking (electric brake).The D51EX uses silicon steel with a magneto-resistance of 1 / several thousand of ferrite magnets to produce a strong magnetic force and a back electromotive force to provide complete self-braking.Excitation power supply for D51EX sold separately was available.

sections.overview: A horn equipped with an acoustic lens.In an acoustic lens, a kind of obstacle is arranged correctly in the path through which sound passes, and sound waves at both upper and lower ends are delayed to obtain spherical waves. Integrated amplifier with 5-band equalizer.The 5-band equalizer circuit can enhance or reduce five frequency bands to 12 dB.When the knob is in the center position, it is completely removed from the signal circuit and the sound of the input source can be confirmed as it is.It is equipped with a phono equalizer amplifier suitable for MM type cartridges.All input, output and data ports are equipped with logic operated electromagnetic magnet switches, and signal switching is realized by digital logic IC.In the relay used in this process, contacts plated with gold, rhodium and ruthenium are enclosed in glass tubes filled with inert and oxygen-free gas to increase reliability.Equipped with a motor drive volume control compatible with a remote control, the resistor is laser trimmed to achieve highly accurate tracking.Equipped with an output auto-former, the amplifier and speaker are always in an ideal matching state, and a long life is realized without losing sound quality.It is equipped with various protection circuits as a risk management measures to protect the amplifier itself and to prevent damage to the speakers in the event of an abnormal situation.Power Guard consists of a waveform comparator that monitors the waveform of the amplifier input and output signal. Normally, it does not output anything. However, when the amplifier is driven to output beyond its maximum power capability and a difference occurs between the input and output waveforms, the comparator controls the amplifier gain to suppress distortion of the output.Equipped with a sentry monitor, it senses the dynamic operating time, voltage and current of the output stage and controls the current within non-destructive limits.Other built-in features include a DC hoar to ground the DC, temperature protection that does not degrade SN by natural air cooling, turn-on delay that delays the operation of the amplifier by approximately two seconds when the power is turned on, and in-rush protection that eliminates stress on the power transformer when the power is turned on.It is equipped with a gold plated input / output jack.Stainless steel chassis is used for the chassis.Serial data output port is installed.Equipped with a large blue eyes output display meter with lighting.Wireless remote control is included.

This is a preamplifier created from uncompromising traditional craftsmanship.An output of 12W + 12W is available at the speaker connection terminal on the rear panel. When used in conjunction with an input selector switch, it is also possible to drive an active speaker system.The headphone port on the front can be driven by either a dynamic type or a condenser type and has a dedicated volume.FET is used for all input changeover switches.Minute DC voltage turns ON/OFF the FET, does not affect the frequency characteristics, and suppresses the generation of switching noise.Equipped with a 5-band program, equalizer and defeat switch.Adjustment of   12 dB is possible around 30 Hz, 150 Hz, 500 Hz, 1500 Hz and 10000 Hz.It is equipped with separate switches for both playback and recording. It is possible to record FM broadcasting while playing a record or monitor each of them independently.Equipped with a logalism expander circuit, the dynamic range is logarithmically expanded and corrected, while noise such as hum, hiss and scratches is reduced.The red LED indicates the function and shows the operation status of each push button switch on the front panel.The power sensitive outlet circuit (SCR) automatically turns on the power of the preamplifier when the player operates, and turns off when the player is turned off.This function can also be turned OFF.The power transformer is triple shielded with copper plate, silicon steel plate and metal case to remove hum and improve the SN ratio.It is rectified at 24 v output voltage and supplied to the monitor amplifier.In addition, 18 v is divided from the output voltage and supplied to the constant voltage circuit and OP amplifier circuit through the IC voltage control circuit.The Phono equalizer amplifier uses four low-noise transistors with low impedance.To achieve this low-noise effect, a 68-ohm feedback circuit is used.The loudness circuit, equalizer and bandpass filter are all composed of an ion-coupled electrolytic differential amplifier (OP amplifier).A special relay is mounted to eliminate the transient phenomenon caused by ON/OFF of the power switch.This relay is operated by a transistor switch and sends the output of the preamplifier to the output terminal.The transistor switch incorporates a capacitor with a long time constant and a capacitor with a short time constant. The former capacitor controls the relay so that the signal turns ON approximately two seconds after the power is turned ON, and the latter capacitor controls the relay so that the signal turns OFF just before the power is turned OFF.

Based on the C40, this control amplifier has been improved by further refining the technology and know-how accumulated so far.Using an equalizer circuit with the latest design of an operational amplifier, the distortion and noise characteristics are driven by the optimum NFB, and high-precision metal-coated resistors and high-quality polypropylene capacitors are used to achieve the strict RIAA curve characteristics.A read relay-type electromagnetic switch that controls digital signals is used for the switching elements of nine input / output signals to reduce signal degradation.This relay is gold-plated and then re-plated with rhodium and rhenium to improve the reliability of the contacts. In addition, a glass tube filled with inert gas is used to prevent an increase in contact resistance due to corrosion.The C42 takes advantage of the input selector function and separates the controller and signal processing circuit to provide a layout with the shortest distance from the input to the output for signal purification.It is equipped with an 8-band equalizer function which is an extension of the conventional 5-band equalizer function.This equalization function can be used by switching between the playback and recording channels. In the center position, the equalizer circuit is completely off so that a flat frequency response can be obtained.A fully balanced digital control attenuator provides 0.5 dB, 213 step fine control and a wide dynamic range of 116 dB.The control circuit uses four attenuators for balanced transmission and a dual monolithic circuit driven by 16-bit serial data. This realizes a precision of less than 0.05 dB step error in a 0.5 dB variable range.The built-in 0 crossing detector reduces digital noise when the volume is up or down.The blue 4-digit fluorescent indicator displays the volume in dB or% in the center of the panel, as well as left and right balance adjustments.A source trim function is built in to align the input levels.It is equipped with a locker switch. When it is not used for a long period of time, if this switch is turned on, it becomes a standby state and the value stored in the body can also be kept.With two input selectors, you can record one source and listen to other sources at the same time. This is equipped with an individual listening function and a recording input selection function.The dual processor loop function allows you to connect an equalizer for sound field correction to each of the playback and recording systems.The front panel also has a processor loop on/off switch.Wireless remote control is included.

Audio control center that supports 6 ch (5.1 ch) input.Two 6-channel input terminals and one RCA/XLR output terminal are installed.The subwoofer channel has essentially flat transmission characteristics and is designed to insert and release base management circuitry as needed, so it can be converted to a surround back channel by changing its settings.The built-in level trim function allows you to adjust the volume level of the subwoofer, surround speakers, and center speaker to match the front L/R during multi-channel playback.This adjustment can be performed at any time during program source playback.The 6-channel master volume employs a high-precision digital control system using a 128 step optical rotary encoder. It has a resolution of 0.5 dB and a tracking accuracy of 0.1 dB. Moreover, residual noise is greatly reduced by linking a post-attenuator installed after the 20 dB gain stage. The volume level is displayed as a percentage on the fluorescent display.(The 2004 catalog described it as a digitally controlled volume with a 128 step optical rotary encoder, but the 2007 catalog described it as a 214 step digital electronic volume.)It is equipped with a programmable input selector.An electromagnetic switching system unique to Macintosh is used for signal switching.In this system, precise contact electrodes plated with gold, rhodium, and ruthenium are placed inside a glass tube filled with inert gas, and they are opened and closed by switching on and off an external magnetic field. Therefore, this system is maintenance-free and does not generate measurable distortion.Ruthenium is an excellent contact material, but to protect delicate contacts from impact, the entire switch assembly is housed in an anti-vibration housing.The fluorescent display employs a uniform illumination structure using light diffusion fiber that improves visibility without compromising the external design.Equipped with a tone control circuit.The entire circuit can be turned off with a bypass switch, or it can be programmed on / off for each input.Built-in phono equalizer circuit for MM cartridges.This circuit has an extremely high open-loop gain, but the impedance of the feedback network is completely reduced to minimize distortion and noise.In addition, a powerful current amplifier stage with an output of over 100 mW is installed in the final stage to ensure a wide dynamic range and drive margin.You can optionally add an FM/AM tuner module.The panel display and tuning function are automatically set at the time of installation.Equipped with a high-quality headphone output terminal using a dedicated amplifier.It is equipped with various data ports for centralized control of Macintosh peripheral devices and Route 3 remote power control terminals.Equipped with an auto-mute function that delays start-up for approximately two seconds in order to cut transient noise from input devices when power is turned on.It comes with a wireless remote controller that enables integrated use of Macintosh products such as CD players.We can control other companies' products by using the data port together with the RCT-4 translator accessory.

Search for McIntosh products by Yahoo!  Search for used audio on Yahoo Auction!

This control amplifier was announced as the flagship model of the Macintosh.Inheriting the dual chassis used in the C100, analog circuits are concentrated in the lower chassis and power and control systems are housed in the upper chassis.This configuration separates the analog circuit from the noise of the power supply and control system, and eliminates mutual interference.It is equipped with a fully balanced circuit and all stages from input to output are balanced.In addition to the amplifier circuit, input switching and volume control are also arranged on the + side and - side of each channel.A separate power supply circuit is installed in each amplifier section, and double wiring is provided from each power supply to the signal circuit.A monolithic ceramic capacitor is connected in parallel to the electric field capacitor of the power supply to ensure decoupling of the power supply over the audio band and RF spectrum.The power transformer is double-shielded with copper and iron to prevent noise from the transformer from entering the signal.The relay switch uses a high-grade relay with gold-plated contacts and then plated with rhodium and ruthenium, which is considered to be the best contact material. In addition, inert gas is injected into the relay switch to prevent reliability.In order to be compatible with analog disks, a phono equalizer is mounted. With an open loop gain as high as 10,000, low noise and low distortion are achieved by an appropriate NF circuit.In addition, it is equipped with an input transformer dedicated to the MC cartridge, uses silver wire for the winding, and is housed in a single mu metal shield.It is equipped with an input level matching function, and it is possible to set the volume for each input in the memory and align each level.The volume control stage is well balanced, and a total of four microprocessor-controlled high-precision logarithmic attenuator sections are installed on the + side and - side of each of the left and right channels. This eliminates common noise and distortion, achieves accurate tracking accuracy, and realizes 213 steps in 0.5 db increments with an error of   0.05 db or less.In addition, three control patterns are available to take advantage of processor control : Slow covers the entire dynamic range the entire dynamic range, Fast with one revolution, and VRV with a volume curve that is equivalent to a normal ???????????????.There are also two modes for the balance control. One click corresponds to 1 dB, and the knob is slowly rotated in 1 dB steps, while the knob is rapidly rotated to obtain a large change.After the volume control stage is a discrete balance amplifier, each pair driving the left and right balance outputs.Equipped with a setup menu function, you can adjust the brightness of the display, display the selected source in full word or short, trim source to align each input level, switch source on / off to skip input selection, select volume control mode, select balance control mode, pass-through, and select remote control mode.A pass-through circuit allows the front left and right audio signals from the home theater processor to pass through the C200 as is.It has an extra audio output for multiple amplifier speakers.It is equipped with a control jack capable of turning power on/off such as power amplifier from C200.Equipped with a muting circuit to cancel noise at on/off time.Both input and output connectors use gold plating with excellent corrosion resistance.If the microprocessor is locked up, it can be reset by pressing and holding the red power button for more than two seconds.When the system is not used for a long period of time, the value calibrated in the non-volatile memory is retained by the rocker switch.It comes with a multi-functional remote control that can be used with a Macintosh CD player or FM/AM tuner.

  2,400,000 (a set of two cars, around 2000)

This is a Macintosh flagship model monaural power amplifier that realizes a large output of 1200W.It is equipped with full double balanced circuit from input to output.This circuit consists of two symmetrical amplifiers with the same characteristics, each receiving the + and - sides of the signal. Distortion is canceled by integrating them with a Macintosh auto-former. negative feedback is minimized as much as possible, and odd-order harmonic distortion, which is an especially unpleasant sound, is suppressed.The output transformer has excellent broadband characteristics of 15 Hz to 100 kHz, supports 2  , 4   and 8   loads, protects the speaker from damage due to faulty output transistors, etc., and can supply peak current exceeding 200A.It is equipped with an output current storage function to support low-impedance speakers.In tone burst, 5,000W output is possible.The power meter is equipped with the Blue Eyes Power Meter which is a traditional Macintosh.This meter shows the actual output power by multiplying the output voltage by the current. The meter itself is housed in a glass housing and the lighting can be turned off.In meter mode, the WATTS position indicates the volume change of the program source. In HOLD position, the maximum power is indicated.Equipped with 6 kinds of protection circuits, it protects the amplifier and speaker in case of abnormal situation.The Power Guard consists of a waveform comparator that monitors the waveforms of the input and output signals of the amplifier. When the total harmonic distortion exceeds 0.3%, the gain of the amplifier is suppressed and the output is suppressed to low distortion.In a sentry monitor, a very low impedance is applied to the output due to a sudden short circuit to prevent a destructive current from flowing.In the case of temperature protection, the temperature sensor senses abnormal high temperature of the amplifier, mutes the input, and automatically turns on when the amplifier cools down.With delayed turn-off, when the MC1201 is powered on, the operation of the amplifier is delayed for approximately two seconds to prevent noise that causes unpleasant noise from other devices.There is also a DC protection circuit in case of amplifier failure. If DC is mixed in the output, the auto-former cuts it and protects the speaker from DC.The power line in-rush protection circuit is mounted, and the in-rush current when the power is turned on is relaxed by the thermistor in the power transformer primary circuit.Transistors with a stable current gain over the entire operating current range, low capacity, and a wide safe operating range are selected and used.For passive elements in the signal path, high-precision metal-coated resistors with extremely low voltage coefficients and low-dielectric-absorption film capacitors are used.The XLR with balanced XLR connectors and unbalanced RCA connectors.In addition, the output terminal uses a large five way gold-plated binding post that enables long-life and distortion-free connection, and is also compatible with banana plugs.It has a remote power control device that turns on MC1201 when you turn on the control center of Macintosh.

This circuit becomes high impedance when the output level exceeds the rated value, but this has no effect on the output. When the output reaches its maximum value, the monitoring circuit limits the signal supplied to the output transistor to prevent shorting of the output of the amplifier or damage to the output transistor. This monitoring circuit monitors the plus and minus sides of the output signal separately.In order to improve the stability and sound quality of reproduced sound, it is equipped with Power Guard System which is a unique new circuit.In this circuit, the Normal (green) and Limit (red) lamps on the front panel are operated by a waveform comparison circuit unique to Macintosh. In this case, the amplifier still exhibits the rated maximum output. The input waveform and the output waveform are compared by an IC differential amplifier, and the waveform difference due to distortion of the output waveform is converted into a voltage. This voltage is amplified approximately 100 times supplied to a Schmidt trigger circuit through a full-wave rectifier circuit.The Limit lamp also lights up when the amp is overloaded. Even if the overload condition is very short, the lamp remains on for a period of time that is sufficiently visible. In this case, the meter displays less than 200W. Again, the voltage obtained from the waveform difference is used. M-2000/5 :   7,900 (around 1966)M-2000/e :   9,700 (around 1966)

Based on the technology and data accumulated in the M-1007 series, the MM type cartridge was developed as a stereo cartridge of the micro M-2000 series.Diamond needle is used for M-2000/5, and ellipse needle is used for M-2000/e.In order to demonstrate the excellent characteristics of the light alloy pipe type cantilever, we try to minimize the total mass by fitting it into a micro size cylindrical ferrite magnet with a very natural shape, avoiding extreme bending and deformation.As a result, the magnet and cantilever are almost integrated, making it possible to obtain a higher resonance point in the high-frequency range, improving the frequency characteristics and channel separation in the high-frequency range.The damper uses a special rubber developed through numerous trial measurements and hearing tests in order to select the material of the damper. As a result, in addition to the miniaturization of the effective mass, compliance is improved, high-frequency nobi is achieved, and distortion is reduced.The magnetic circuit uses a well-balanced 4-pole 4-coil system.This method can effectively use the flux without loss, making it possible to extract an output voltage of 5 mV despite the small magnet.In addition, S/N has been improved by fully shielding with super permalloy with less distortion.The natural diamond tip made in Switzerland is mounted with a strict check for each piece to improve the quality.The needle replacement is a plug-in method with a mold tip, and the vibration system can be easily replaced as it is.Since the screw holes conform to JIS and EIA standards, it can be used as it is for tone arms conforming to the standards.The needle pressure is designed so that around 1g is the proper needle pressure.

sections.title: MICRO VF-3000E
sections.overview: This VF (variable flux) type stereo cartridge was developed based on the results of R & D and experience with the M-1007 series and M-2000 series announced by Micro-Seiki Co., Ltd. as the final version of MM type cartridge.We have succeeded in changing the cross-sectional area and shape of the cantilever in one piece for the first time in Japan by developing our own precision machining technology.The rear part of the cantilever is made into a rectangular column shape, and the vibrator is contained in it. The part which changes from the rectangular column shape to the cylindrical part is made into a conical shape, and a special curing process is applied on it.As a result, the cantilever can be regarded as one rigid body, and the pick-up force for sharp transients and large amplitude in low frequencies, which was difficult with conventional methods, has been improved.A twin damper system has been adopted for the damper part, and two types of damper materials with different hardness, viscosity, and elasticity have been successfully integrated at the molding stage without sticking together.Since this twin damper is a composite of two types of damper materials with different characteristics, special characteristics that cannot be obtained with conventional dampers can be obtained.Since the rear end of the conical cantilever is supported by a special twin damper, compliance is large, and changes in the vibrator can be extracted as changes in magnetic flux.In addition, along with the high compliance, the tracking ability to the sound groove of the needle tip is improved, and the resonance point in the high-frequency range can be raised.Natural diamond elliptical needle of 0.8 mil long diameter and 0.3 mil short diameter is used for the needle tip.The elliptical needle reduces the pinch effect distortion and tracing distortion compared to the round needle, realizes the characteristics of frequencies above 25 kHz, and improves the channel separation in the high frequency range.Since the needle replacement is a plug-in method with a mold tip, it can be replaced with the same feeling as MM type.Since the screw holes conform to JIS and EIA standards, the tone arm based on this standard can be mounted as it is.

sections.overview: This CD player was developed based on the technology and know-how accumulated through analog players.Large rigidity is obtained by hollowing out and attaching solid aluminum high-speed steel of 15 mm thickness for the front panel and 10 mm thickness for the side panel to the minimum necessary outside of the aluminum die-cast chassis.A lead sheet is inserted between the bottom plate and bottom plate and the chassis to ensure sufficient mass for eliminating resonance. In addition, the tray mechanism and the top cover are provided with a ferrite vibration control sheet to suppress resonance and obtain a large effect.To minimize electromagnetic vibration from the transformer itself, the power supply section uses a short ring, a ham proof belt, and a copper-plated shield case to prevent magnetic flux leakage that may adversely affect other circuits.The secondary winding has three independent circuits for the digital circuit, analog circuit and display circuit to prevent interference between the circuits.Both the digital circuit board and the analog circuit board are completely shielded with a large copper plated cover to prevent the high frequency of the digital circuit from interfering with the analog circuit due to unnecessary radiation.A simple, all-IC balanced out circuit uses capacitors such as ERO and Telefunken, and PCOCC thick wires to achieve higher quality playback.The CFC panel is finished with satin, hairline treatment and titanium color.The side and top panels have a black rabbi paint.The legs have a highly stable 3-point layout, and a chrome plating finish is used for the pure brass removal.In addition, we have adopted a two way foot that can be used for both rigid type and pallet type depending on the condition of the place.

sections.title: MICRO AP-M1
sections.overview:
300,000 (around the latter half of 1980 s?)

This record player was developed by condensing the high-inertia concept realized in the SX 8000 II into an integrated small player and taking into consideration the design concept of the first micro CD player, the CD-M2.In order to completely eliminate the influence of external vibration and reproduce the analog source more pure, we have developed an oil floating suspension and adopted it in the AP-M1.This system consists of a high-precision floating spring with upper and lower diaphragms filled with damping oil, and a damping plate to absorb vibration. As a result, we have obtained the best howling margin in our class.This suspension can be adjusted by a 3-point screw at the top of the body.For the turntable, we have adopted a super-heavy composite double-structure turntable with a high-inertia concept, inheriting the blood line of the SX 8000 II. In order to rotate this turntable stably, we have also adopted the same control system as the SX 8000 II.The structure of the motor is a motor unit with a built-in ultra-small BTL amplifier. A high-precision 8-pole synchronous motor is driven by a bi-amplifier. In addition, the precise pitch of this motor is controlled by the frequency with a CR oscillator achieve more stable rotation.The main body of the player uses Micro's know-how over many years to implement a unique vibration control design that thoroughly examines the physical characteristics of the material.First of all, the floating base is made of a new COSMAL ZMII, which is far superior to cast iron and aluminum alloys in terms of toughness and vibration control. In addition, the arm base is also made of COSMAL ZMII, which suppresses internal and external vibration and realizes excellent S/N.The insulator has a three layer structure consisting of damping alloy, ferrite damping material and felt.The side panel uses the same material made by Solidwood Brazilian Rose as CD-M2.The power supply and drive circuit are completely separated and independent from the body. This method reduces the influence of flux, etc. from the power supply to the drive mechanism.The drive circuit is the same as that of the SX 8000 II. By changing the motor torque between starting and playing, more stable rotation characteristics are achieved.In addition, the automatic switching design enables quick start-up at 100 V at start-up and more stable driving at 50 V at constant speed, resulting in excellent start-up and smooth rotation.In order to cancel the play caused by the slight clearance between the center hole of the disk and the spindle, a unique spindle structure is adopted.By changing the tapered center spindle to a movable shaft with a combination of a spring and damping oil, misalignment is eliminated and wow flutter is reduced.A special balanced output phono equalizer is sold separately and can be mounted on the back panel.

sections.title: MICRO BL-81
sections.overview: The RX-5000 and BL-111 have taken advantage of the direct coupling system, which has gained a reputation. By combining the heavy duty turntable with the belt drive system, the player system improves overall player performance.The direct coupling system integrates the rotating mechanism (large shaft assembly) and shaft assembly) and an arm mount are integrated into a metal frame. This structure makes the vibration circulation system in phase, shortens the vibration circulation system, and improves rigidity.By minimizing the phase shift of the vibration mode between the turntable and the arm support to zero, the needle tip is not shaken by unnecessary vibration, enabling more faithful record reproduction.A special aluminum turntable with a diameter of 306 mm and a weight of 3.2 kg is used for the turntable, and a 16 cm series extra-thick stainless steel shaft is used for the supporting shaft.The moment of inertia of 550 kg ? cm2Inertia.The tone arm is based on the MA 505 XII, which has a unique mechanism that allows the needle pressure to be adjusted during performance, and has been further improved. The improvement is that by adopting the arm pipe replacement system, the straight pipe with excellent strength and the S-shaped arm pipe that can be used with all cartridges can be replaced.Each pipe is made of brass, and an ultra-low resistance connector for computers is used to connect the pipe to the body to prevent energy conversion loss.In addition, the straight pipe, in particular, has an integrated structure with the head shell using a special high-rigidity aluminum material to further increase the strength and prevent resonance.The signal cable uses a completely separate system to prevent harmful induction noise, and uses 30-core pure copper wire with a diameter of 0.05 mm.By reducing the cabinet width to 48.4 cm, it is compatible with commercially available racks.Also, it is finished with urethane finish.

sections.title: MICRO BL-101
sections.overview: This is an armless player that pursues higher perfection by introducing various technologies such as the direct coupling method which gained a reputation in RX 5000 and BL 111.The vibration mode is thoroughly analyzed by the Structural Dynamic Analyzer, and Micro's unique direct coupling method is adopted. In this method, the shaft assembly of the turntable and the arm mount are completely integrated with the connecting frame, the vibration circulation system is in phase, and the turntable and the arm do not cause any phase shift due to vibration, enabling more accurate tracing.In addition, this integrated structure makes the vibration circulation system as short as possible and increases the rigidity, minimizing the conversion loss when the cartridge converts the vibration energy from the sound groove into an electric signal.The turntable section uses special aluminum for the main turntable (305 mm diameter) and zinc for the sub turntable (180 mm diameter), and adopts a double turntable system in which the surfaces are firmly joined by three screws.The joint surface has a flat surface by high-precision polishing which Micro boasts. This double structure dumps the main turntable's squeal and improves the playback sound by adding weight to the sub-turntable and increasing the moment of inertia.In addition to the conventional tapered connection method, a more reliable press-fit method has been adopted for connecting the sub-turntable and turntable shaft to clarify the fulcrum point.The bearing portion of the turntable shaft is 12 mm longer in the radial direction than that of BL-91 to eliminate play caused by clearance with the bearing.The 16 mm diameter high rigidity shaft (stainless steel copper) is housed in a large bearing assembly and is an oil bath system filled with special synthetic oil.A strobe light is mounted on the back of the outer circumference of the main turntable and can be checked from the front by a reflecting mirror.Uses an insulator that takes external vibration and howling into consideration.The cabinet has a urethane finish with a natural wood tack plate finish.In addition, the dust cover is laminated with acrylic resin and adopts V-cut structure.One A-1200 series is attached to the arm mount base.

sections.title: MICRO DD-10
sections.overview: A direct drive player with separate power transformer structure.The power transformer in which the power transformer is separated from the main body, S/N is improved by eliminating the influence of the power transformer.This outer power trans configuration reduces the effect of leakage flux to cartridges with poor shielding and low-power cartridges, resulting in clearer playback sound.Two AC outlets are arranged in this power supply.A 20 pole, 60 slot brushless DC servo motor has been adopted for the motor part to obtain excellent characteristics.The turntable has an inertial mass of 330 kg ? cm.2It uses an aluminum die-cast large turntable. The density is equalized by the original casting method, and the deviation at 900 revolutions by the balancing machine is kept within 2g. In addition, 315g and 1 cm for rubber sheet.2High-density sheet of about 1.2g per sheet is used to prevent resonance.The tone arm adopts a universal type static balance type arm that uses the rotating part of MA-202 as it is.High precision pivot and original angular type bearings are combined for the vertical bearings of the rotating part, and radial type bearings are used for the upper and lower points of the water plain bearing part to achieve an initial horizontal and vertical sensitivity of 10 mg or less.The main weight for needle pressure adjustment is a one turn direct reading type between 0 and 3g. By adjusting the horizontal balance of the arm and the needle pressure indicator to 0, the proper needle pressure of the used cartridge can be obtained correctly.A sub-weight (sold separately) can be attached to the rear.In order to check the horizontal balance of the arm depending on the height of the cartridge in use, it is equipped with a helicoidal arm height adjustment mechanism. This adjustment mechanism allows fine adjustment within 6 mm.In addition, the cartridge is equipped with a variable inside for scan cellar that can handle the needle pressure. With the unique variable structure that can handle the needle pressure, the cancellation amount changes relative to the outer and inner surfaces of the record, so the imbalance of the needle pressure caused by the inside force can be eliminated and the tracing capacity of the cartridge is improved.The arm lifter has an oil dump-type delay operation to smooth the contact and release between the record surface and needle tip.The head shell uses H-202, an aluminum die cast head shell, and the connector pin is gold-plated to prevent contact failure. In addition, the head lock connector part at the tip of the arm is equipped with a head shell inclination adjusting screw to enable vertical adjustment.The rotational speed is changed electronically with a micro switch, and fine adjustment can be performed within   6% at each speed.The cabinet adopts a double structure of die-cast frame and solid base, and measures against howling are taken.In addition, by installing large absorbers on the legs, the effect of vibration is reduced. These absorbers are height adjustable.Equipped with a mirror-type strobe with a precision strobe placed behind the turntable.The output code is a low-capacitance type of 50pF/m, which reduces the influence on the high-frequency characteristics and supports 4-channel playback.

sections.title: MIRAGE M-1
sections.overview:
1,040,000 (a set of two cars, around 1990)

A speaker system incorporating bipolar technology to improve directivity.Wide-directional speaker units are placed on the front and rear baffles to drive in phase.In the case of a rear open type bipolar flat plate speaker, it was not possible to realize such wide-directional characteristics because it is generally a plane wave with opposite phases in front and rear and it is strongly affected by phase interference. However, with this technology, almost 360 degree non-directional diffusion characteristics are obtained.M-1 is a 3-way 6-unit configuration.Each band consists of a ???????? dome tweeter that maintains quick transient characteristics and low distortion rate flat response over a 180 degree directional range in the high-frequency range. In the mid-frequency range, a high-speed response wide-band mid-range with a 3-layer laminate carbon-added polypropylene light-mass cone is adopted. In the low-frequency range, a special treatment is applied and carbon-added polypropylene, nitrile PVC edge, and a high input-resistant long-stroke woofer with aluminum voice coil bobbin is adopted.The enclosure uses CAD design and CAM processing technology to limit dimensional error to   100 microns.In addition, high density fiberboard is used and the generation of natural resonance and standing wave is eliminated by strong tongue joint structure, internal partition wall and solid angle reinforcement.All units are flush capes submerged in the baffle surface to avoid the influence of diffracted waves. In addition, the corners are curved, and the grill cloth is fixed on the same plane as the baffle with no gap so as not to interfere with good diffusion patterns.The surface finish of the wooden part is black gloss finish.The network section is developed by computer modeling to ensure the most neutral response and tone balance in all 360   directions, and is tuned with carefully selected parts and hearing tests.The input terminal supports bi-wiring and bi-amplifier.

sections.title: MURATA ES301
sections.overview:
* Built to orderES301 (black lacquer finish) :   499,800 (1 unit, tax included, sold on November 1, 2004)ES301R (wine red piano finish) :   531,300 (1 unit, tax included, sold on November 1, 2004)

This floor-type speaker system was developed using original technologies such as a hemispherical unit.The ES301 uses Eddy Control Technology (eddy current control drive system) to eliminate eddy current generated by pressure difference between the air pushed by the diaphragm and surrounding air.In this system, auxiliary speakers are installed at the top and bottom of the woofer, where the vibration amplitude of the diaphragm is large and there is a high possibility of air turbulence due to the pressure difference. Thus, eddy currents are suppressed by reducing only the discontinuity of the pressure difference near the main speaker without any time difference or phase difference, thereby enhancing the low-range reproduction capability, especially in the sense of hearing.Three 10-cm flat woofers are installed in the lower range.A honeycomb diaphragm and double-edge structure are used for the vibration system to ensure high tracking and linearity of the diaphragm.Equipped with an 8 cm semi-spherical squaker as a middle and high area unit.Piezoelectric ceramics with high rigidity is adopted for the diaphragm. By making it into a hemisphere shape, wide directivity by spherical wave and high resonance frequency are obtained. In addition, generation of unnecessary divided vibration is suppressed. This piezoelectric ceramic diaphragm is directly driven by an input signal, so there is no delay and high tracking performance is possible.The Ultimate Support System is used for the enclosure.In a normal speaker, the amplitude of the woofer causes a swing around the bottom of the speaker. The range of the swing becomes larger as the speaker moves toward the upper part of the housing. This affects a low-amplitude tweeter or an additional super-tweeter.In order to solve this problem, the center of gravity support structure consists of an independent housing for each driver unit inside the casing to increase the rigidity of the casing. While maintaining airtightness from the bottom of the casing, solid supports penetrate through the center of the casing, and the upper center of gravity is supported by pinpoints.The enclosure is made of MDF, the exterior is reinforced with Nunohiki, and has a traditional Japanese lacquer finish. There is also an optional lustrous wine-red finish.
